name: bgd-rice-variety-register
title: Bangladesh Rice Variety Register: officially approved rice varieties, with improved fish strains
description: Every rice variety officially approved in Bangladesh (National Seed Board meetings 1 to 115, 1974 to 5 February 2026, and the varieties recommended before the Board existed), with the evidence for every value, the Board's decisions, official lists, CGIAR links, pedigrees, improved fish strains and government acts on fish. fields.name: rice_type_basis

fields.name: name_class
fields.title: Kind of name

fields.name: likely_origin
fields.title: Likely origin
fields.description: Origin of the name as far as a source in the archive states it; 'unknown' otherwise. Values: Free text.

fields.name: origin_basis
fields.title: Basis of origin
fields.description: File and page, or table row, supporting likely_origin. Values: Free text.

fields.name: cgiar_role
fields.title: CGIAR code
fields.description: CGIAR code assigned under the register's rules for cgiar_role, so that non-approved names can enter CGIAR shares. 5 means no CGIAR link is documented, not that there is none. Values: 1-5 as in bgd_rice_varieties.csv.

fields.name: cgiar_center
fields.title: CGIAR centre
fields.description: CGIAR centre of the documented link. Blank for code 5. Values: AfricaRice.

fields.name: cgiar_basis
fields.title: Basis of CGIAR code
fields.description: Why the code was assigned, with the register rows it relies on. Values: Free text.

fields.name: spia_dna_note
fields.title: SPIA DNA finding
fields.description: What SPIA's DNA fingerprinting found for samples reported under this name (SPIA Bangladesh Study 2025), with page. Values: Free text; blank when SPIA reports nothing.

fields.name: spia_self_report_note
fields.title: SPIA self-report share
fields.description: Self-reported adoption of the name in the SPIA 2023-24 survey, with table and page. Values: Free text; blank when SPIA reports nothing.

fields.name: in_crosswalk
fields.title: Used in crosswalk
fields.description: Whether any survey code list in the crosswalk uses the identifier. Values: Y; N.

fields.name: crosswalk_occurrences
fields.title: Codes in surveys
fields.description: Source, instrument version and code of every survey list entry carrying the identifier. Values: '<source> <instrument_version>: code <n>[, <n>]' joined by '; '.

fields.name: rice_plot_reports
fields.title: Rice plot reports
fields.description: Number and share of rice plot reports carrying the name in each survey round; the denominator is every rice plot report with a variety code (see 06_validation/crosswalk_plot_coverage.csv). Values: '<round>: <n> (<share>%)' joined by '; '; blank when no plot carries it.

resources.name: bgd_nsb_decisions_full
resources.title: One NSB decision on one variety
resources.description: Every decision of the National Seed Board on a rice variety found in the minutes of meetings 1 to 115, with the full verbatim text of the agenda item, the passage and segment that concern the variety, the raw OCR or text layer, and each attribute the decision states (breeding line, origin, DUS and VCU results, yield, duration, quality, conditions, CGIAR mentions) in its own column with a validation code for every number. Verbatim columns are in Bangla as printed. A decision on several varieties appears once per variety.

fields.name: dec_id
fields.title: Decision identifier
fields.description: Identifier of one NSB decision on one variety. An agenda item that decides on several varieties produces one row per variety. Values: Short code assigned during extraction (e.g. 'd001', 'b83r2', 'f5m_061a'); unique, but carries no meaning beyond identity.

fields.name: variety_id
fields.title: Variety identifier
fields.description: Register identifier of the variety the decision concerns. Blank when the decision names a variety that could not be matched to the register (pilot_key 'UNMATCHED'), for example a rejected or non-rice entry. Values: 'RICE-' followed by a key built from the official name by lib_keys.make_key: BR<n> (BR series, 1970-1993), BRRI_DHAN<n>, BRRI_HYBRID<n>, BINADHAN<n>, IRATOM<n>, BINASHAIL, BU_, BAU_ and GAU_ (universities), BRAC_DHAN<n>, PVT_ (other private inbreds), HYB_<trade name> (private and BADC hybrids), IR<n> and OLD_ (pre-BRRI introductions and old names).

fields.name: variety_name
fields.title: Display name
fields.description: Uniform display name of the matched variety (see bgd_rice_varieties.csv). Blank when variety_id is blank. Values: Free text; for private hybrids the registration or trial code is added in parentheses where one is known, e.g. 'Partex hybrid dhan6 (HR-30)'. Unique within the register.

fields.name: pilot_key
fields.title: Matching key
fields.description: Key used to match the decision to the register, before the 'RICE-' prefix is added. 'UNMATCHED' marks decisions on names that are not in the register. Values: Register key, or UNMATCHED, or blank.

fields.name: variety_name_as_printed
fields.title: Variety name as printed
fields.description: Name of the variety as written in the minutes, with any breeding line or trade name printed beside it. Values: Bangla or English as printed.

fields.name: meeting_no
fields.title: NSB meeting number
fields.description: Serial number of the National Seed Board meeting. Values: Integer 1-115.

fields.name: meeting_date
fields.title: NSB meeting date
fields.description: Date on which the National Seed Board meeting was held. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: meeting_date_validation
fields.title: Validation of meeting date
fields.description: How the meeting date was checked. Values: key_check (a date or number matched the validated NSB meeting-date key); visual_check (read by eye on the page image or a crop of it); two_source (two independent sources give the same value); unvalidated (machine-readable text or OCR not checked by eye).

fields.name: agenda_item
fields.title: Agenda item
fields.description: Number of the agenda item (আলোচ্যসূচী) under which the decision was taken, as printed. Blank when the minutes do not number the item. Values: Usually an integer; a few Bangla digits or letters as printed.

fields.name: agenda_heading_verbatim
fields.title: Agenda heading
fields.description: Heading of the agenda item, verbatim, up to 400 characters. Values: Bangla text as printed (OCR or converted text layer).

fields.name: decision_type
fields.title: Decision type
fields.description: Type of decision the Board took on the variety, as classified when the minutes were read. Values: release; release_provisional; registration_provisional; registration_conditional; registration_full; registration_extension; rename; suspension; condition_change; status_change; denotification_proposed; approval_deferred; re_trial; approval_denied; gazette.

fields.name: source_id
fields.title: Source identifier
fields.description: Identifier of the minutes document, shared with bgd_sources.csv and bgd_conflicts.csv. Values: NSB_<meeting range or number> or NSB_R<n> (SCA activity reports that compile minutes).

fields.name: source_file
fields.title: Archived file
fields.description: Path of the source file inside the archive, relative to the archive root. Every value in the archive can be traced to a page of a file under 02_raw/. Values: Relative path beginning '02_raw/'; the SHA-256 of each file is in bgd_sources.csv.

fields.name: pages
fields.title: Pages
fields.description: PDF page or pages of source_file on which the agenda item is printed. Values: Integer or range 'a-b'.

fields.name: source_url
fields.title: Original URL of main source
fields.description: Web address from which the main source file of the row was downloaded. For the rice register this is the file that supplied the approval record (approval_date); for other tables it is the file that supplied the row. Values: Absolute http(s) URL. Many Government of Bangladesh files are served from an Oracle object-storage address rather than a portal page; that is the address the portal links to.

fields.name: text_source
fields.title: Text source
fields.description: Which text the verbatim columns were taken from. Values: text_layer (Bijoy text layer converted to Unicode; meetings 58-75); ocr (Tesseract OCR of the page image); ocr_columns (OCR words re-assigned to the columns of a ruled two-column table).

fields.name: anchor_status
fields.title: How the item was located
fields.description: How the decision was located in the minutes text. A '; passage=anchor_paragraph' suffix means the variety passage could not be isolated by name and the paragraph holding the anchor line is given instead. Values: regex, regex2 (hand-written pattern); alt, alt2 (breeding-line or name variant); token (number token near the expected page); with optional suffixes '; passage=anchor_paragraph' or '; passage_not_isolated'.

fields.name: n_decisions_in_item
fields.title: Decisions in the same item
fields.description: Number of variety decisions taken under the same agenda item. Values above 1 mean the item text is shared and the variety-specific columns were cut from a multi-variety passage. Values: Count, 1 or more.

fields.name: breeding_line
fields.title: Breeding line as printed
fields.description: Breeding line or trial code printed with the variety in the minutes. Values: As printed.

fields.name: pedigree_cross
fields.title: Cross as printed
fields.description: Pedigree or derivation of the variety as printed in the minutes (for example 'Basmati(D) x BR5'). Origin statements are moved to germplasm_source. A few cells hold a misplaced value (for example 'nationwide') carried over from the reading sheet. Values: As printed.

fields.name: pedigree_statements
fields.title: Pedigree sentences
fields.description: Sentences in the variety passage that mention parentage or crossing. Values: Verbatim sentences matched by keyword, joined by ' ‖ '. Keyword matching can pick up sentences about other matters in the same agenda item, so read them against variety_passage_verbatim.

fields.name: hybrid_parent_female_A_line
fields.title: Hybrid A line
fields.description: Female (CMS) parent line of a hybrid where the minutes print it. Values: As printed.

fields.name: hybrid_maintainer_B_line
fields.title: Hybrid B line
fields.description: Maintainer line of a hybrid where the minutes print it; empty in the current release. Values: As printed.

fields.name: hybrid_parent_male_R_line
fields.title: Hybrid R line
fields.description: Restorer (male) parent line of a hybrid where the minutes print it. Values: As printed.

fields.name: hybrid_parent_statements
fields.title: Hybrid parent sentences
fields.description: Sentences that mention hybrid parent lines, their import or local production. Values: Verbatim sentences matched by keyword, joined by ' ‖ '. Keyword matching can pick up sentences about other matters in the same agenda item, so read them against variety_passage_verbatim.

fields.name: germplasm_source
fields.title: Germplasm source
fields.description: Statement of where the seed or germplasm came from, as printed. Values: Free text, Bangla or English; equals origin_statements in the current build.

fields.name: origin_country
fields.title: Origin country
fields.description: Country of origin of the seed or germplasm read from the minutes, with any correction noted. Values: Country names in English, sometimes with a correction note.

fields.name: origin_statements
fields.title: Origin sentences
fields.description: Sentences that state the origin of the variety or its seed. Values: Verbatim sentences matched by keyword, joined by ' ‖ '. Keyword matching can pick up sentences about other matters in the same agenda item, so read them against variety_passage_verbatim.

fields.name: developer_applicant
fields.title: Developer or applicant
fields.description: Institute or company that proposed or imported the variety, as listed in the index and, where found, as printed in the passage ('as printed: ...'). Values: Free text; ' | as printed: ' separates the index value from the printed one.

fields.name: season
fields.title: Season
fields.description: Season for which the decision approves the variety, in English. Values: Aus; Aman; Boro; Rope (transplanted) Aman or Aus; qualifiers as written.

fields.name: region_scope
fields.title: Approved region (summary)
fields.description: Region for which the decision approves the variety, summarised in English. Values: 'nationwide' or a list of regions or towns.

fields.name: region_text
fields.title: Region sentences
fields.description: Sentences of the decision that name the approved area. Values: Verbatim sentences matched by keyword, joined by ' ‖ '. Keyword matching can pick up sentences about other matters in the same agenda item, so read them against variety_passage_verbatim.

fields.name: dus_result
fields.title: DUS result
fields.description: Result of the Distinctness, Uniformity and Stability test as described in the minutes. Values: Verbatim text.

fields.name: dus_statements
fields.title: DUS sentences
fields.description: Sentences about the DUS test. Values: Verbatim sentences matched by keyword, joined by ' ‖ '. Keyword matching can pick up sentences about other matters in the same agenda item, so read them against variety_passage_verbatim.

fields.name: dus_years
fields.title: DUS years
fields.description: Number of years or seasons of DUS testing. Values: Integer, sometimes with years in parentheses.

fields.name: dus_distinct_traits_n
fields.title: Distinct DUS traits
fields.description: Number of traits on which the variety was found distinct from the check. Values: Count.

fields.name: dus_check_variety
fields.title: DUS check variety
fields.description: Variety against which distinctness was tested. Values: As printed (Bangla).

fields.name: vcu_statements
fields.title: VCU sentences
fields.description: Sentences about the Value for Cultivation and Use trials. Values: Verbatim sentences matched by keyword, joined by ' ‖ '. Keyword matching can pick up sentences about other matters in the same agenda item, so read them against variety_passage_verbatim.

fields.name: vcu_regions_n
fields.title: VCU regions
fields.description: Number of regions in which VCU trials were held. Values: Count.

fields.name: vcu_sites_n
fields.title: VCU sites
fields.description: Number of VCU trial sites. Values: Count, occasionally with a qualifier.

fields.name: vcu_trial_type
fields.title: VCU trial type
fields.description: Whether the VCU trials were on research stations, on farms or both. Values: on-station; on-farm; 'on-station; on-farm'.

fields.name: check_variety
fields.title: Check variety
fields.description: Check variety of the VCU trials as printed. Values: Bangla text as printed.

fields.name: yield_t_ha
fields.title: Yield (t/ha)
fields.description: Yield reported for the variety in the trials described in the decision. Values: Tonnes per hectare.

fields.name: yield_criterion_pct
fields.title: Yield criterion (%)
fields.description: Yield advantage over the check as stated in the decision; for most hybrid registrations the registration criterion that was met (at least 20 or 5 percent over the check), not a measured gain. Renamed from yield_advantage_pct in v1.2. Values: Percent, sometimes with a qualifier such as '(at 6 of 10 sites)'.

fields.name: yield_statements
fields.title: Yield sentences
fields.description: Sentences that report yields. Values: Verbatim sentences matched by keyword, joined by ' ‖ '. Keyword matching can pick up sentences about other matters in the same agenda item, so read them against variety_passage_verbatim.

fields.name: duration_days
fields.title: Growth duration (days)
fields.description: Growth duration reported in the decision. Values: Days.

fields.name: duration_statements
fields.title: Duration sentences

fields.name: special_traits_official
fields.title: Special traits
fields.description: Special characteristics stated in the decision. Values: Verbatim text.

fields.name: identifying_traits_official
fields.title: Identifying traits
fields.description: Identifying characteristics stated in the decision; empty in the current release. Values: Verbatim text.

fields.name: grain_type
fields.title: Grain type
fields.description: Grain shape and size as printed (for example চিকন, মাঝারি মোটা). Values: Bangla as printed.

fields.name: grain_quality_statements
fields.title: Grain quality sentences
fields.description: Sentences that describe grain quality. Values: Verbatim sentences matched by keyword, joined by ' ‖ '. Keyword matching can pick up sentences about other matters in the same agenda item, so read them against variety_passage_verbatim.

fields.name: amylose_pct
fields.title: Amylose (%)
fields.description: Amylose content of the grain. Values: Percent; a few values carry '>' as printed.

fields.name: lb_ratio
fields.title: Length-breadth ratio
fields.description: Grain length to breadth ratio. Values: Ratio.

fields.name: grain_wt_1000_g
fields.title: 1000-grain weight (g)
fields.description: Weight of 1000 grains. Values: Grams.

fields.name: protein_pct
fields.title: Protein (%)
fields.description: Protein content of the grain. Values: Percent.

fields.name: zinc_mg_kg
fields.title: Zinc (mg/kg)
fields.description: Zinc content of the grain. Values: Milligrams per kilogram.

fields.name: iron_mg_kg
fields.title: Iron (mg/kg)
fields.description: Iron content of the grain, with the Board's comment where it made one. Values: Milligrams per kilogram; text where brown and polished values or a comment are given.

fields.name: stress_tolerance
fields.title: Stress tolerance
fields.description: Tolerance and resistance statements in the decision. Values: Verbatim text.

fields.name: tc_recommendation_text
fields.title: Technical Committee recommendation
fields.description: Text of the NSB Technical Committee recommendation on which the decision rests, verbatim. Values: Bangla text.

fields.name: decision_text
fields.title: Decision text
fields.description: Decision paragraph or paragraphs (সিদ্ধান্ত) of the agenda item that name the variety, verbatim. When no decision paragraph names it, decision paragraphs that are not about another crop are given. Values: Bangla text; paragraphs separated by blank lines.

fields.name: decision_conditions
fields.title: Conditions
fields.description: Conditions attached to the decision, verbatim. Values: Bangla text.

fields.name: import_period
fields.title: Import conditions
fields.description: Sentences of the conditions that concern seed import (আমদানি). Values: Sentences joined by ' ‖ '.

fields.name: provisional_years
fields.title: Provisional period (years)
fields.description: Length in years of a provisional or time-limited approval. Values: Years.

fields.name: label_requirements
fields.title: Labelling requirements
fields.description: Sentences that set packet or label requirements (প্যাকেট, লেবেল). Values: Sentences joined by ' ‖ '.

fields.name: cgiar_mentions
fields.title: CGIAR mentions
fields.description: Sentences that mention IRRI, IR lines, INGER or other CGIAR elements. Values: Verbatim sentences matched by keyword, joined by ' ‖ '. Keyword matching can pick up sentences about other matters in the same agenda item, so read them against variety_passage_verbatim.

fields.name: cgiar_lineage
fields.title: CGIAR link in words

fields.name: cgiar_role
fields.title: CGIAR involvement code
fields.description: CGIAR involvement code supported by this decision alone; the register's cgiar_role combines all sources. Values: 1-5 as in bgd_rice_varieties.csv.

fields.name: cgiar_center
fields.title: CGIAR centre
fields.description: CGIAR centre named in the decision. Values: IRRI; AfricaRice.

fields.name: cgiar_quote
fields.title: CGIAR quote
fields.description: Exact words of the minutes that support cgiar_lineage. Values: Verbatim, mostly Bangla.

fields.name: page
fields.title: Page
fields.description: Page of the source file on which the value is printed, counted as the PDF page (1 = first page of the file), not the number printed on the page. Values: Integer page number, or a range 'a-b' when the item spans pages. Blank for web pages, spreadsheets and API records.

fields.name: n_words
fields.title: Words recognised
fields.description: Number of words with a confidence score on the page. Values: Count.

fields.name: mean_word_conf
fields.title: Mean word confidence
fields.description: Mean Tesseract word confidence. Values: 0-100, one decimal.

fields.name: median_word_conf
fields.title: Median word confidence
fields.description: Median Tesseract word confidence. Values: 0-100, one decimal.

fields.name: pct_words_conf_below_60
fields.title: Share of low-confidence words
fields.description: Percentage of words with confidence below 60. Values: Percent, one decimal.

fields.name: n_values
fields.title: Values taken from page
fields.description: Number of OCR'd evidence values taken from the page. Values: Count.

fields.name: n_key_check
fields.title: Values key-checked
fields.description: Of these, values validated against the NSB meeting-date key. Values: Count.

fields.name: n_visual_check
fields.title: Values read by eye
fields.description: Of these, values checked by eye on the page image. Values: Count.

fields.name: n_unvalidated
fields.title: Values unvalidated
fields.description: Of these, values not checked. Unvalidated OCR never enters the register. Values: Count.

resources.name: bgd_ocr_pages
resources.title: One page of an official document
resources.description: The text corpus of the official documents (minutes, gazettes, lists, laws, notices, leaflets): for every page, the full OCR text with word confidence and, where the PDF has a usable one, its own text layer. It allows full-text search and re-checking of any value against the page.

fields.name: source_file
fields.title: Archived file
fields.description: Path of the source file inside the archive, relative to the archive root. Every value in the archive can be traced to a page of a file under 02_raw/. Values: Relative path beginning '02_raw/'; the SHA-256 of each file is in bgd_sources.csv.

fields.name: page
fields.title: Page
fields.description: Page of the source file on which the value is printed, counted as the PDF page (1 = first page of the file), not the number printed on the page. Values: Integer page number, or a range 'a-b' when the item spans pages. Blank for web pages, spreadsheets and API records.

fields.name: source_url
fields.title: Original URL of main source
fields.description: Web address from which the main source file of the row was downloaded. For the rice register this is the file that supplied the approval record (approval_date); for other tables it is the file that supplied the row. Values: Absolute http(s) URL. Many Government of Bangladesh files are served from an Oracle object-storage address rather than a portal page; that is the address the portal links to.

fields.name: ocr_engine
fields.title: OCR engine
fields.description: OCR engine and settings. Blank when the page was not OCR'd. Values: e.g. 'Tesseract 5.4 ben+eng tessdata_best, psm 6, 300 dpi'.

fields.name: full_ocr_text
fields.title: OCR text
fields.description: Complete, untruncated OCR text of the page. OCR of Bangla print is imperfect; use it for search, not as a transcription. Values: Text with line breaks.

fields.name: mean_word_conf
fields.title: Mean word confidence
fields.description: Mean Tesseract confidence of the recognised words on the page. Values: 0-100.

fields.name: median_word_conf
fields.title: Median word confidence
fields.description: Median Tesseract word confidence. Values: 0-100.

fields.name: pct_words_conf_below_60
fields.title: Share of low-confidence words
fields.description: Percentage of words with confidence below 60. Values: Percent, 0-100.

fields.name: n_words
fields.title: Words recognised
fields.description: Number of words recognised on the page. Values: Count.

fields.name: text_layer_text
fields.title: Text layer
fields.description: The PDF's own text layer when usable: Bijoy (SutonnyMJ) spans converted to Unicode, other fonts kept raw. Characters of fonts with no Unicode map are replaced by '[?]'. Blank when the file has no usable text layer. Values: Text.

fields.name: n_pages
fields.title: Pages in file
fields.description: Number of pages in the source file. Values: Count.

fields.name: doc_class
fields.title: Document class
fields.description: Kind of document. Values: minutes; gazette; official_list; law_rule_procedure; notice; leaflet; other_official.

fields.name: coverage_status
fields.title: Text coverage
fields.description: Which texts exist for the page. Values: ocr only; ocr + text layer; text layer only; not OCR'd, no usable text layer; OCR'd: no text recognised (blank or image-only page).

fields.name: text_layer_note
fields.title: Text layer note
fields.description: Fonts of the text layer and why it was used or judged unusable. Values: Free text.

fields.name: ocr_note
fields.title: OCR note
fields.description: Note on the OCR of the page; empty in the current release. Values: Free text.

fields.name: png_path
fields.title: Page image
fields.description: Path of the 300-dpi page image that was OCR'd. Values: Path under 03_extracted/text/ocr/.

fields.name: ocr_txt_path
fields.title: OCR text file
fields.description: Path of the cached OCR text file. Values: Path under 03_extracted/text/ocr/.

resources.name: bgd_official_list_rows_full
resources.title: One printed cell of an official list
resources.description: Every printed cell of every official rice variety list in the archive (the SCA compendium of 2016, the SCA annual inbred and hybrid lists, the Ministry of Agriculture hybrid lists of 1998-2016, 2018, 2020 and 2026, and the Bangladesh Gazette release notices), one row per cell, with the cell text verbatim, a normalised value where a rule exists, the matched variety and how the cell was read. Wide versions (one row per printed row) are in 03_extracted/tables/.

fields.name: list_id
fields.title: List identifier
fields.description: Identifier of the official list or gazette notice the cell belongs to. Values: SCA2016_COMP_INBRED, SCA2016_COMP_HYBRID (SCA compendium, imprint 2014, issued 2016); SCA_FY<yyyy-yy>_INBRED and SCA_FY<yyyy-yy>_HYBRID (SCA annual lists); MOA_HYBRID_1998_2016, MOA_HYBRID_2018, MOA_HYBRID_2020, MOA_HYBRID_2026 (Ministry of Agriculture cumulative hybrid lists) and their _SEASON_SUMMARY tables; GZ_<yyyy-mm-dd> (Bangladesh Gazette release notices).

fields.name: list_title
fields.title: List title as printed
fields.description: Title of the list as printed, with an English note on the edition where needed. Values: Bangla text as printed.

fields.name: fy_or_edition
fields.title: Edition
fields.description: Edition of the list: the fiscal year, the date to which the list is complete, or the gazette date. Values: 'FY2025-26', an ISO date, a year range, or '2016 (imprint 2014)'.

fields.name: source_file
fields.title: Archived file
fields.description: Path of the source file inside the archive, relative to the archive root. Every value in the archive can be traced to a page of a file under 02_raw/. Values: Relative path beginning '02_raw/'; the SHA-256 of each file is in bgd_sources.csv.

fields.name: page
fields.title: Page
fields.description: Page of the source file on which the value is printed, counted as the PDF page (1 = first page of the file), not the number printed on the page. Values: Integer page number, or a range 'a-b' when the item spans pages. Blank for web pages, spreadsheets and API records.

fields.name: row_no
fields.title: Row number
fields.description: Position of the printed row within the list (or within the page for some lists). Row 0 holds title, banner and other metadata cells that belong to no variety. Values: Integer, 0 or more.

fields.name: variety_id
fields.title: Variety identifier
fields.description: Register identifier of the variety in this printed row. Blank for metadata cells (row 0) and for the rare row whose name could not be matched. Values: 'RICE-' followed by a key built from the official name by lib_keys.make_key: BR<n> (BR series, 1970-1993), BRRI_DHAN<n>, BRRI_HYBRID<n>, BINADHAN<n>, IRATOM<n>, BINASHAIL, BU_, BAU_ and GAU_ (universities), BRAC_DHAN<n>, PVT_ (other private inbreds), HYB_<trade name> (private and BADC hybrids), IR<n> and OLD_ (pre-BRRI introductions and old names).

fields.name: variety_name
fields.title: Display name
fields.description: Display name of the matched variety. Values: Free text; for private hybrids the registration or trial code is added in parentheses where one is known, e.g. 'Partex hybrid dhan6 (HR-30)'. Unique within the register.

fields.name: column_header_as_printed
fields.title: Column header as printed
fields.description: Header of the column the cell belongs to, as printed. Values: Bangla text as printed.

fields.name: column_header_en
fields.title: Column header in English
fields.description: English translation of the column header. Values: Free text.

fields.name: cell_text_verbatim
fields.title: Cell text
fields.description: Text of the printed cell, verbatim, including ditto marks (ঐ, 'as above'), Bangla digits and printing errors. Values: Unicode text as printed.

fields.name: cell_value_normalised
fields.title: Normalised value
fields.description: Machine-readable form of the cell where a rule exists (meeting number and date, years, numbers). Blank for cells that have no normalised form, such as names and remarks. Values: For meeting cells 'NSB <n> = YYYY-MM-DD'; otherwise ASCII numbers or ISO dates.

fields.name: validation
fields.title: Validation
fields.description: How the value was checked after extraction. Unvalidated OCR values are kept in the evidence but never enter the register. Values: key_check (a date or number matched the validated NSB meeting-date key); visual_check (read by eye on the page image or a crop of it); two_source (two independent sources give the same value); unvalidated (machine-readable text or OCR not checked by eye).

fields.name: source_url
fields.title: Original URL of main source
fields.description: Web address from which the main source file of the row was downloaded. For the rice register this is the file that supplied the approval record (approval_date); for other tables it is the file that supplied the row. Values: Absolute http(s) URL. Many Government of Bangladesh files are served from an Oracle object-storage address rather than a portal page; that is the address the portal links to.

fields.name: col_index
fields.title: Column position
fields.description: Position of the column in the printed table, counted from the left (0 for metadata). Values: Integer 0-10.

fields.name: serial_as_printed
fields.title: Serial number as printed
fields.description: Serial number (ক্রমিক নং) printed at the start of the row. Values: As printed, often Bangla digits.

fields.name: column_kind
fields.title: Column kind
fields.description: Standard meaning of the column, used to map list cells to register fields. Values: name; serial; crop; developer; origin; season; region; meeting_date; release_year; duration; yield; identifying_traits; special_traits; remarks; institute_banner; meta.

fields.name: method
fields.title: Transcription method
fields.description: How the cell was read, in words. Values: visual_check variants (transcribed by eye from page crops) or bijoy2unicode text-layer variants (some checked by eye against crops).

fields.name: locator
fields.title: Image crop
fields.description: Path of the page crop used to read the cell, or another locator. Values: Relative path under 04_working/crops/.

fields.name: uncertain
fields.title: Uncertain reading
fields.description: Note on a reading the transcriber could not settle (handwritten digits, stamps, stray marks). A cell with a note here is marked unvalidated. Values: Free text; blank for nearly all cells.

fields.name: key_basis
fields.title: Matching rule
fields.description: How the printed row was matched to a register variety. Values: For example 'lib_keys.make_key / F3L key_of on the name cell', 'exact name match to MoA 2026 row', 'F3H match report'.

fields.name: notes
fields.title: Notes
fields.description: Transcriber's notes on the cell (merged cells, banners carried from an earlier page). Values: Free text.

resources.name: bgd_pedigree_ancestors
resources.title: One ancestor of one variety along one path
resources.description: Every ancestor of every register variety with a parsed pedigree, traced through register parents and sister lines to the fifth generation, with the path, the ancestor's nominal genetic share under equal parental contribution (backcross doses respected) and whether it is a CGIAR line. It is the input for CGIAR attribution in the manner of Raitzer et al. (2015) and SPIA (2025); the per-variety measures are in bgd_pedigree_summary.csv.

fields.name: variety_id
fields.title: Variety identifier
fields.description: Register variety whose ancestry is listed. Values: 'RICE-' followed by a key built from the official name by lib_keys.make_key: BR<n> (BR series, 1970-1993), BRRI_DHAN<n>, BRRI_HYBRID<n>, BINADHAN<n>, IRATOM<n>, BINASHAIL, BU_, BAU_ and GAU_ (universities), BRAC_DHAN<n>, PVT_ (other private inbreds), HYB_<trade name> (private and BADC hybrids), IR<n> and OLD_ (pre-BRRI introductions and old names).

fields.name: variety_name
fields.title: Variety name
fields.description: Display name of the variety. Values: Free text.

fields.name: ancestor_label
fields.title: Ancestor
fields.description: The ancestor: the register name when it resolves to a register variety, otherwise the line or landrace as printed. Values: Free text.

fields.name: ancestor_id
fields.title: Ancestor variety
fields.description: Register variety the ancestor resolves to (bgd_pedigree_edges.csv parent_id). Blank for lines that are not register varieties. Values: variety_id; blank.

fields.name: ancestor_kind
fields.title: Kind of ancestor
fields.description: What the ancestor is. Values: register variety; CGIAR line; other line (breeding lines and landraces outside the register).

fields.name: generation
fields.title: Generation
fields.description: Generation of the ancestor relative to the variety: 1 parent, 2 grandparent (or parent of an unnamed F1 inside a composite cross), 3 great-grandparent, up to 5; 0 for the source of a mutant, somaclone or selection, which has the same genetic content as the variety. Values: Integer 0-5.

fields.name: path
fields.title: Path
fields.description: Chain from the variety to the ancestor, for example 'BRRI dhan29 > BR10 > IR20'. '(unnamed F1)' marks the F1 inside a composite cross; '[sister of X]' marks a sister line whose parents are taken from register variety X. Values: Names joined by ' > '.

fields.name: parent_role
fields.title: Role at the last step
fields.description: Role of the ancestor in the cross or derivation that produced the next name on the path. Values: female; male (first and second parent of a cross); recurrent; donor (backcross); mutant_source; somaclone_source; selection_source; unknown.

fields.name: contribution_share
fields.title: Nominal genetic share
fields.description: Nominal share of the variety's genome from this ancestor along this path, under equal parental contribution: 0.5 per generation; in 'A*n/B' the recurrent parent A has 1 - 0.5^n and the donor 0.5^n (BC1, A*2/B: 0.75 and 0.25; 'BCn' as printed means n+1 doses); a mutant, somaclone or selection source has 1. Where the printed formula gives more parents than its order of crosses allows, the shares are rescaled to sum to 1. An ancestor reached by two paths has two rows. Values: 0-1.

fields.name: ancestor_is_cgiar_line
fields.title: Ancestor is a CGIAR line
fields.description: Whether the ancestor is a CGIAR line (same rule as parent_is_cgiar_line in bgd_pedigree_edges.csv). Values: Y; N.

fields.name: ancestor_cgiar_center
fields.title: CGIAR centre of ancestor
fields.description: CGIAR centre of the ancestor line. Values: IRRI; AfricaRice; blank.

fields.name: first_cgiar_on_path
fields.title: First CGIAR line on the path
fields.description: Y when the ancestor is a CGIAR line and no CGIAR line sits between it and the variety. Sum contribution_share over these rows (generation <= 3) to get the nominal CGIAR share without double counting the ancestors of a CGIAR line. Values: Y; N.

fields.name: ancestry_untraced
fields.title: Ancestry not traced
fields.description: Y when the ancestor is a breeding line or bred variety (its designation contains a number), is not a CGIAR line, and its own parents cannot be traced in the archive, so whatever lies above it is unknown. Values: Y; N.

fields.name: sister_of_id
fields.title: Sister line of
fields.description: For an ancestor that is a sister line, the register variety from the same cross whose parents are used. Values: variety_id; blank.

resources.name: bgd_pedigree_edges
resources.title: One parent-child link
resources.description: Parent-child links parsed from the published pedigrees in the register, with the parent's role, backcross dose, generation, whether the parent is a CGIAR line, and the register variety it resolves to where it does, and the register variety a sister-line parent shares its cross with.

fields.name: child_id
fields.title: Child variety
fields.description: Register variety whose pedigree is described. Values: 'RICE-' followed by a key built from the official name by lib_keys.make_key: BR<n> (BR series, 1970-1993), BRRI_DHAN<n>, BRRI_HYBRID<n>, BINADHAN<n>, IRATOM<n>, BINASHAIL, BU_, BAU_ and GAU_ (universities), BRAC_DHAN<n>, PVT_ (other private inbreds), HYB_<trade name> (private and BADC hybrids), IR<n> and OLD_ (pre-BRRI introductions and old names).

fields.name: child_name
fields.title: Child name
fields.description: Display name of the child variety. Values: Free text.

fields.name: parent_label_as_printed
fields.title: Parent as printed
fields.description: Parent or source line as written in the pedigree. Values: Free text.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.title: Parent variety
fields.description: Register variety the parent label resolves to by identity (name key, exact name or alias, or breeding line). Never by similarity. Blank when the parent is not a register variety. Values: 'RICE-' followed by a key built from the official name by lib_keys.make_key: BR<n> (BR series, 1970-1993), BRRI_DHAN<n>, BRRI_HYBRID<n>, BINADHAN<n>, IRATOM<n>, BINASHAIL, BU_, BAU_ and GAU_ (universities), BRAC_DHAN<n>, PVT_ (other private inbreds), HYB_<trade name> (private and BADC hybrids), IR<n> and OLD_ (pre-BRRI introductions and old names).

fields.name: sister_of_id
fields.title: Sister line of
fields.description: Register variety that comes from the same cross as the parent line printed in the pedigree (same cross number, different selection). The parent line itself is not a register variety; its parents are taken to be those of the documented cross. Values: variety_id; several joined by ' | ' if more than one register variety shares the cross; blank otherwise.

fields.name: parent_role
fields.title: Parent role
fields.description: Role of the parent in the cross or derivation. Values: female; male (first and second parent of a cross); recurrent; donor (backcross); mutant_source; somaclone_source; selection_source; unknown.

fields.name: backcross_dose
fields.title: Backcross dose
fields.description: Number of doses of the recurrent parent in 'A*n/B' notation. Values: Integer, or BC<n> as printed.

fields.name: parent_is_cgiar_line
fields.title: Parent is a CGIAR line
fields.description: Whether the parent is a CGIAR line (IR, IRBB/IRBL, IRRI, IRGC, NERICA, WAB designations, or a register variety that is itself a CGIAR line). Values: Y; N.

fields.name: parent_cgiar_center
fields.title: CGIAR centre of parent
fields.description: CGIAR centre of the parent line. Values: IRRI; AfricaRice.

fields.name: source_column
fields.title: Column parsed
fields.description: Register column (or other source) the edge was read from. Values: Free text.

fields.name: source_file
fields.title: Source file
fields.description: File the edge was read from. Values: Paths joined by '; '.

fields.name: note
fields.title: Note
fields.description: How the parent was resolved, or why not. Values: Free text.

fields.name: generation
fields.title: Generation
fields.description: Generation of the parent relative to the child: 1 for direct parents, 2 for parents of an unnamed F1 inside a composite cross, and so on; 0 for mutant, somaclone and selection sources, which share the child's generation. Values: Integer 0-4.

resources.name: bgd_pedigree_founders
resources.title: One ancestor line or variety
resources.description: For every line or variety that has register descendants, the number of register varieties descending from it in any generation, by decade of approval, the generations involved and the list of descendants. The 12 ancestors with most descendants are marked; the lineage graph for the website is 05_output/final/bgd_lineage_graph.json (nodes and parent -> child edges).

fields.name: founder_rank
fields.title: Rank by descendants
fields.description: Rank of the ancestor by n_descendants (ties broken by the earlier approval year). Values: 1 upwards.

fields.name: ancestor_id
fields.title: Ancestor variety
fields.description: variety_id when the ancestor is a register variety. Values: variety_id; blank.

fields.name: ancestor_node
fields.title: Node identifier
fields.description: Identifier of the ancestor in bgd_lineage_graph.json: the variety_id, or 'L:' and the normalised designation of a line. Values: Text.

fields.name: ancestor_label
fields.title: Ancestor
fields.description: Name or designation of the ancestor. Values: Free text.

fields.name: ancestor_kind
fields.title: Kind of ancestor
fields.description: What the ancestor is. Values: register variety; CGIAR line; other line.

fields.name: ancestor_is_cgiar_line
fields.title: Ancestor is a CGIAR line
fields.description: Whether the ancestor is a CGIAR line (including register varieties that are CGIAR lines released directly). Values: Y; N.

fields.name: ancestor_cgiar_center
fields.title: CGIAR centre of ancestor
fields.description: CGIAR centre of the ancestor. Values: IRRI; AfricaRice; blank.

fields.name: ancestor_year
fields.title: Approval year of ancestor
fields.description: Approval year when the ancestor is a register variety. Values: Year; blank.

fields.name: cross_family
fields.title: Cross number
fields.description: Cross number at the head of the ancestor's line designation (BR1185, IR5); lines with the same cross number are sisters. Values: Text; blank.

fields.name: n_descendants
fields.title: Register descendants
fields.description: Number of register varieties descending from the ancestor in any generation, through printed pedigrees, sister lines and line designations (edges of bgd_lineage_graph.json). Values: Count.

fields.name: n_children
fields.title: Register children
fields.description: Number of register varieties whose printed pedigree names the ancestor directly (any generation inside one formula). Values: Count.

fields.name: n_1960s
fields.title: Descendants approved in the 1960s
fields.description: Number of the register descendants approved in the 1960s (approval_year). Values: Count.

fields.name: n_1970s
fields.title: Descendants approved in the 1970s
fields.description: Number of the register descendants approved in the 1970s (approval_year). Values: Count.

fields.name: n_1980s
fields.title: Descendants approved in the 1980s
fields.description: Number of the register descendants approved in the 1980s (approval_year). Values: Count.

fields.name: n_1990s
fields.title: Descendants approved in the 1990s
fields.description: Number of the register descendants approved in the 1990s (approval_year). Values: Count.

fields.name: n_2000s
fields.title: Descendants approved in the 2000s
fields.description: Number of the register descendants approved in the 2000s (approval_year). Values: Count.

fields.name: n_2010s
fields.title: Descendants approved in the 2010s
fields.description: Number of the register descendants approved in the 2010s (approval_year). Values: Count.

fields.name: n_2020s
fields.title: Descendants approved in the 2020s
fields.description: Number of the register descendants approved in the 2020s (approval_year). Values: Count.

fields.name: generations
fields.title: Generations involved
fields.description: Distinct generation distances from the ancestor to its register descendants (shortest path; 0 = mutant or selection). Values: Integers joined by '|'.

fields.name: max_generation
fields.title: Deepest generation
fields.description: Largest of the generation distances in generations. Values: Integer.

fields.name: first_descendant_year
fields.title: First descendant approved
fields.description: Approval year of the earliest register descendant. Values: Year.

fields.name: descendant_ids
fields.title: Descendants
fields.description: variety_id of every register descendant, in order of approval year. Values: variety_id joined by '|'.

fields.name: top12
fields.title: Among the 12 main founders
fields.description: Y for the 12 ancestors with the most register descendants (founder_rank <= 12); these are the founders the website draws. Values: Y; N.

resources.name: bgd_pedigree_summary
resources.title: One register variety
resources.description: For each register variety, the number of parents parsed, the number of generations to the nearest documented CGIAR ancestor, that ancestor, the chain that leads to it and the parse status, with two working columns used to check cgiar_role; CGIAR attribution measures (nominal IRRI and CGIAR genetic shares, the Raitzer et al. 2015 attribution weight with the weight left in untraced ancestry) and SPIA's Table 27 flags as separate Y/N columns.

fields.name: variety_id
fields.title: Variety identifier
fields.description: Stable identifier of a rice variety in the register and the key for joining every table in the archive. The number inside the identifier is the official series number of the variety, not a running count. Values: 'RICE-' followed by a key built from the official name by lib_keys.make_key: BR<n> (BR series, 1970-1993), BRRI_DHAN<n>, BRRI_HYBRID<n>, BINADHAN<n>, IRATOM<n>, BINASHAIL, BU_, BAU_ and GAU_ (universities), BRAC_DHAN<n>, PVT_ (other private inbreds), HYB_<trade name> (private and BADC hybrids), IR<n> and OLD_ (pre-BRRI introductions and old names).

fields.name: n_parents_parsed
fields.title: Direct parents parsed
fields.description: Number of direct parents (generation 0 or 1) parsed from the pedigree. Values: Count.

fields.name: depth_to_cgiar
fields.title: Generations to nearest CGIAR ancestor
fields.description: Number of generations between the variety and the nearest CGIAR line in its documented pedigree: 0 when the variety is a CGIAR line or a mutant, somaclone or selection of one, 1 when a parent is a CGIAR line, 2 for a grandparent, and so on. Blank means no CGIAR line was found within five generations of the documented pedigree, including the many varieties with no pedigree at all. Values: Integer 0-5; blank.

fields.name: nearest_cgiar_ancestor
fields.title: Nearest CGIAR ancestor
fields.description: Name or designation of the CGIAR line found at depth_to_cgiar (for example 'IR20', 'IR8', 'Oryza rufipogon (IRGC103404)'). For a mutant, somaclone or selection made directly from a CGIAR line (depth 0) it is the source line (NERICA-10 for Binadhan-19, IR8 for Iratom-24); a register variety (such as BR6) appears when it is itself a CGIAR line introduced and released. Values: Free text as printed in the pedigree.

fields.name: pedigree_parse_status
fields.title: Parse status
fields.description: What the pedigree parser could do with the variety's pedigree. Values: parsed; parsed_untraced_lines (parents include institute lines that cannot be traced in the register); statement_only (only a statement such as 'line collected from IRRI'); none (no pedigree).

fields.name: cgiar_path
fields.title: Path to CGIAR ancestor
fields.description: Chain from the variety to its nearest CGIAR ancestor. Values: '<variety> <-g<n>- <ancestor>' links, with mutant_source, selection_source or somaclone_source for derivations and '[sister of ...]' for sister lines.

fields.name: current_cgiar_role
fields.title: cgiar_role in register
fields.description: cgiar_role of the variety in the register when the pedigree was built (working column). Values: 1-5.

fields.name: implied_cgiar_role
fields.title: cgiar_role implied by pedigree
fields.description: cgiar_role that the parsed pedigree alone implies; a check against the register, not a value written to it (working column). Values: 1-5, rules in scripts/build_pedigree.py.

fields.name: irri_share_nominal
fields.title: IRRI genetic share (nominal)
fields.description: Nominal share of the variety's genome that comes from IRRI lines up to the great-grandparents, assuming each parent contributes half (backcross doses respected): the sum of contribution_share over the first IRRI line on each path in bgd_pedigree_ancestors.csv with generation <= 3. 1 for an IRRI line released directly. Not an attribution weight. Values: 0-1; blank when no parents were parsed.

fields.name: cgiar_share_nominal
fields.title: CGIAR genetic share (nominal)
fields.description: As irri_share_nominal, counting lines of any CGIAR centre (IRRI and AfricaRice). Values: 0-1; blank when no parents were parsed.

fields.name: irri_weight_raitzer
fields.title: IRRI attribution weight (Raitzer rule)
fields.description: Share of the credit for the variety attributed to IRRI under the last-cross and geometric rules of Raitzer et al. (2015, pp. 31-32, Table 2.1, column D) as used by SPIA for BRRI dhan28 and dhan29. An IRRI line released directly (or a mutant or selection of one) gets 1. A cross made by a national programme keeps 0.5 for the cross; the other 0.5 is shared by pedigree, 0.25 for the parent generation, 0.125 for grandparents and 0.125 for great-grandparents, so an IRRI parent with half the genome earns 0.25 (including its own ancestors), an IRRI grandparent 0.0625. Only IRRI lines traced in the register count; see share_untraced_weight. Values: 0-1; blank when no parents were parsed. Checks: BRRI dhan28 = 0.25 (published 0.25); BRRI dhan29 = 0.125 (published 0.375).

fields.name: cgiar_weight_raitzer
fields.title: CGIAR attribution weight (Raitzer rule)
fields.description: As irri_weight_raitzer, crediting lines of any CGIAR centre. Values: 0-1; blank when no parents were parsed.

fields.name: raitzer_basis
fields.title: Basis of the attribution weight
fields.description: Which branch of the Raitzer rule produced irri_weight_raitzer, or why it was not computed. Values: last-cross rule: IRRI line released directly; last-cross rule: AfricaRice line released directly; last-cross rule: mutant or selection of a CGIAR line; geometric rule: NARS cross with CGIAR material within three generations; geometric rule: NARS cross, no CGIAR line traced within three generations; not computed: no parents parsed; not computed: IRRI ancestry stated, line not named.

fields.name: share_untraced_weight
fields.title: Attribution weight in untraced ancestry
fields.description: Part of the Raitzer pedigree weight (out of 0.5) that sits on ancestors whose CGIAR status is unknown: the ancestors of a breeding line that cannot be traced, and that line's own position unless it is a Bangladeshi institute line (BR, BRRI, BINA and similar). irri_weight_raitzer + share_untraced_weight is an upper bound on the IRRI weight. For BRRI dhan29 the untraced line is BG90-2 (0.25), and the published 0.375 equals the upper bound. Values: 0-0.5; blank when the weight is not computed.

fields.name: irri_weight_raitzer_published
fields.title: IRRI attribution weight as published
fields.description: IRRI attribution weight printed by Raitzer et al. (2015, p. 92, section 3.5.1.2) for the two varieties they attribute. Values: 0-1; blank for all other varieties.

fields.name: breeding_route
fields.title: Breeding route
fields.description: How the variety was made, from the parsed pedigree; independent of cgiar_role: a line introduced and released, a cross, or a mutant, somaclone or pure-line selection of an earlier line. Renamed from cgiar_derivation in version 1.2 so that it is not confused with the register column of that name, which has a different vocabulary. Values: introduction; cross; mutant; somaclone; selection; blank when no pedigree was parsed.

fields.name: spia_in_t27
fields.title: In SPIA Table 27
fields.description: Whether the variety is listed in SPIA (2025) Appendix B, Table 27 (rice varietal releases). Values: Y; N.

fields.name: spia_category
fields.title: SPIA class
fields.description: SPIA's own class for the variety: direct (IRRI's direct contribution), indirect (IR line as one parent) or none. SPIA's definition, not the register's cgiar_role; see 06_validation/cgiar_spia_concordance.csv. Values: direct; indirect; none; blank when not in Table 27.

fields.name: spia_irri_direct
fields.title: SPIA: IRRI direct contribution
fields.description: SPIA Table 27 column 'IRRI's Direct Contribution'. Values: Y; N; blank when not in Table 27.

fields.name: spia_indirect_ir_parent
fields.title: SPIA: indirect contribution (IR line as one parent)
fields.description: SPIA Table 27 column 'Indirect Contribution (IR line as one parent)'. Values: Y; N; blank when not in Table 27.

fields.name: spia_inger_entry
fields.title: SPIA: INGER entry
fields.description: SPIA Table 27 column 'INGER entry'. Values: Y; N; blank when not in Table 27.

fields.name: spia_in_reference_library
fields.title: SPIA: in DNA reference library
fields.description: SPIA Table 27 column 'In our reference library' (the variety is in SPIA's DNA fingerprinting reference set). Values: Y; N; blank when not in Table 27.

fields.name: spia_harvestplus
fields.title: SPIA: HarvestPlus
fields.description: SPIA Table 27 column 'HarvestPlus'. Values: Y; N; blank when not in Table 27.

fields.name: spia_none
fields.title: SPIA: no IRRI contribution
fields.description: Y when SPIA codes neither a direct nor an indirect IRRI contribution. Values: Y; N; blank when not in Table 27.

resources.name: bgd_publications
resources.title: One publication
resources.description: Full bibliographic records of the publications in bgd_literature.csv, as returned by the APIs (authors, affiliations, ORCID iDs, citations, keywords, funders, licence, open-access status, abstract and repository identifiers).

fields.name: pub_id
fields.title: Publication identifier
fields.description: Identifier of the publication, the key for joining bgd_publications.csv. Values: 'doi:<DOI>' when the work has a DOI, otherwise 't:<normalised title>'.

fields.name: doi
fields.title: DOI
fields.description: DOI of the publication, cleaned of URL prefixes and extraction errors. Blank when the work has no DOI in the APIs used. Values: DOI without the https://doi.org/ prefix.

fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Title of the publication. Values: Free text.

fields.name: authors
fields.title: Authors
fields.description: Authors in publication order. Values: Names joined by '; '.

fields.name: affiliations
fields.title: Affiliations
fields.description: Institutional affiliation of each author, as returned by the APIs. Values: '<author>: <institution>' entries joined by ' || '.

fields.name: orcids
fields.title: ORCID iDs
fields.description: ORCID iDs of authors, where registered. Values: '<author>: <ORCID>' entries joined by '; '.

fields.name: corresponding_authors
fields.title: Corresponding authors
fields.description: Corresponding authors where the API identifies them. Values: Names joined by '; '.

fields.name: year
fields.title: Year
fields.description: Year of publication. Values: Four-digit year; blank when the API gives the placeholder 1970 (see year_note).

fields.name: venue
fields.title: Venue
fields.description: Journal, repository or series. Values: Free text.

fields.name: publisher
fields.title: Publisher
fields.description: Publisher of the venue. Values: Free text.

fields.name: volume_issue_pages
fields.title: Volume, issue, pages
fields.description: Volume, issue and page range. Values: 'vol <v>; issue <i>; pp <a-b>' with parts omitted when absent.

fields.name: type
fields.title: Work type
fields.description: Work type as reported by the API that supplied the record; vocabularies differ between APIs and are not harmonised. Values: e.g. article, journal-article, Journal Article, Preprint, dissertation.

fields.name: cited_by_count
fields.title: Citations
fields.description: Number of citing works reported by OpenAlex on the retrieval date. Values: Count.

fields.name: keywords
fields.title: Keywords
fields.description: Author or indexer keywords. Values: Terms joined by '; '.

fields.name: topics
fields.title: Topics
fields.description: OpenAlex topic labels. Values: Labels joined by '; '.

fields.name: countries
fields.title: Author countries
fields.description: Countries of the authors' institutions. Values: ISO 3166 two-letter codes (some full names) joined by '; '.

fields.name: funders
fields.title: Funders
fields.description: Funding bodies named in the record. Values: Names joined by '; '.

fields.name: license
fields.title: Licence
fields.description: Licence of the work as reported; spellings are not harmonised. Values: e.g. cc-by, cc-by-nc, a licence URL.

fields.name: oa_status
fields.title: Open-access status
fields.description: Open-access status as reported by OpenAlex, or the repository's wording for CGSpace. Values: diamond; gold; hybrid; green; bronze; closed; OA; Open Access; Limited Access.

fields.name: affiliations_raw
fields.title: Affiliations (raw strings)
fields.description: Full affiliation strings as printed in the record. Values: '<author>: <string>' entries joined by ' || '.

fields.name: open_access_url
fields.title: Open-access URL
fields.description: Address of a free full-text copy, where the APIs report one. Values: Absolute URL.

fields.name: url
fields.title: URL
fields.description: Landing page of the publication: the publisher page, or https://doi.org/<DOI> when no other address is given or the publisher address is dead. Values: Absolute URL.

fields.name: abstract
fields.title: Abstract
fields.description: Full abstract as returned by the API. Values: Free text.

fields.name: openalex_id
fields.title: OpenAlex ID
fields.description: OpenAlex work identifier. Values: https://openalex.org/W<n>.

fields.name: pmid
fields.title: PubMed ID
fields.description: PubMed identifier. Values: Integer.

fields.name: pmcid
fields.title: PMC ID
fields.description: PubMed Central identifier. Values: PMC<n>.

fields.name: cgspace_handle
fields.title: CGSpace handle
fields.description: Handle of the record in CGSpace, CGIAR's repository. Values: 10568/<n>.

fields.name: cgspace_uuid
fields.title: CGSpace UUID
fields.description: Internal identifier of the CGSpace item. Values: UUID.

fields.name: cg_identifier_url
fields.title: CGSpace identifier URL
fields.description: Alternative address recorded by CGSpace for the item. Values: Absolute URL.

fields.name: language
fields.title: Language
fields.description: Language of the work. Values: ISO 639-1 code (en, de, id, tr).

fields.name: sources
fields.title: APIs that returned the record
fields.description: Bibliographic services that returned the record. Values: openalex; crossref; europepmc; cgspace; joined by '; '.

fields.name: raw_files
fields.title: Raw API files
fields.description: Archived API responses that contain the record. Values: Paths under 02_raw/literature_api/ joined by '; '.

fields.name: varieties_linked
fields.title: Varieties linked
fields.description: Register varieties linked to the publication in bgd_literature.csv. Values: variety_id values joined by '; '.

fields.name: retrieved_at
fields.title: Download date
fields.description: Date on which the main source file was downloaded or the bibliographic record was retrieved. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: year_note
fields.title: Note on the year
fields.description: Why the year is blank: Crossref/OpenAlex give 1970-01-01, a placeholder, for many Bangladesh Journals Online articles. Values: 'year unknown: the bibliographic API gives 1970-01-01, a placeholder date' or blank.

fields.name: doi_status
fields.title: Link status of DOI
fields.description: Result of the automated check of https://doi.org/<DOI>. Values: ok; blocked_to_bots (HTTP 403: the page exists but refuses automated checks); dead (404, 410 or a soft error page); unreachable (DNS, TLS or timeout failure); unchecked. Blank when the link column is blank.

fields.name: url_dead
fields.title: Dead URL
fields.description: The original URL when the automated link check found it dead; the url column then holds a working replacement (usually the DOI link) or is blank. Blank when the original link works. Values: Absolute URL.

fields.name: open_access_url_dead
fields.title: Dead open-access URL
fields.description: The original open-access URL when the automated link check found it dead; the open_access_url column then holds a working replacement (usually the DOI link) or is blank. Blank when the original link works. Values: Absolute URL.

resources.name: bgd_rice_not_approved_or_unresolved
resources.title: One rice name with no documented approval
resources.description: Names that appear in the sources as rice varieties but for which no eligible evidence records an approval event (for example Jirashail, refused in 2022, Iratom-38 and BU Aromatic dhan2). The columns are those of the register before the derived columns are added.

fields.name: variety_id
fields.title: Name identifier
fields.description: Identifier of the name, built in the same way as register identifiers so that it can be joined to bgd_nsb_decisions_full.csv and bgd_variety_status.csv. Values: 'RICE-' followed by a key built from the official name by lib_keys.make_key: BR<n> (BR series, 1970-1993), BRRI_DHAN<n>, BRRI_HYBRID<n>, BINADHAN<n>, IRATOM<n>, BINASHAIL, BU_, BAU_ and GAU_ (universities), BRAC_DHAN<n>, PVT_ (other private inbreds), HYB_<trade name> (private and BADC hybrids), IR<n> and OLD_ (pre-BRRI introductions and old names).

fields.name: variety_name
fields.title: Display name
fields.description: Uniform English display name of the variety, generated from the identifier so that every variety is written the same way (for example 'BRRI dhan29', 'Binadhan-7', 'BRRI hybrid dhan1'). It is intended for display and labelling; the spellings used by the official documents are kept in official_name_en and official_name_bn. Values: Free text; for private hybrids the registration or trial code is added in parentheses where one is known, e.g. 'Partex hybrid dhan6 (HR-30)'. Unique within the register.

fields.name: official_name_en
fields.title: Official English name
fields.description: English name of the variety as printed by the developing institute or another official source, with the source's own spacing and hyphenation (for example 'BAU dhan 2'). Blank means no English spelling was printed; most such rows are private hybrids registered under a Bangla name. Values: Free text as printed.

fields.name: official_name_bn
fields.title: Official Bangla name
fields.description: Bangla name of the variety as printed in the official record, kept exactly as printed, including Bangla digits and the source's own spacing and hyphens (for example 'বিনা ধান-১০'). Values: Bangla text (Unicode, NFC as extracted). Never blank in the register.

fields.name: popular_name
fields.title: Popular name
fields.description: Popular or farmer name given by an official or institute source (for example চান্দিনা for BR1). Blank means no source states one; other names reported by surveys and markets are in bgd_local_names.csv. Values: Free text, usually Bangla.

fields.name: aliases
fields.title: Other labels
fields.description: Other labels under which the variety appears in the sources: breeding-line labels that are not line codes (such as 'BR11-Sub1'), names used before renaming, trade names and codes printed by other sources. It is a record of labels seen in the sources, not a vetted list of local names. Values: Labels separated by ' | ', in order of first appearance.

fields.name: breeding_line
fields.title: Breeding line
fields.description: Pre-release designation of the line that became the variety (for example 'BR7671-37-2-2-3-7-3', 'IR91820-25BAY2-3-1'); for private hybrids, the company's trial or product code (for example 'Win301'). Blank means no line code was published. Values: Designation as printed. Where a source prints the code in both Bangla and Latin script the two forms are joined by '|' without spaces (for example 'বাউ-১৬|BAU-16').

fields.name: pedigree
fields.title: Pedigree (parentage)
fields.description: Parentage of the variety as printed, usually in Purdy notation ('/' a first-order cross, '//' a second-order cross, 'A*n/B' a backcross), or a statement of derivation such as 'mutant of BRRI dhan29' or 'line collected from IRRI, Philippines'. Blank means no pedigree has been published, which is the case for most private hybrids; it does not mean the variety has no known parents. Values: Free text as printed. Parsed parent-child links are in bgd_pedigree_edges.csv.

fields.name: hybrid_parent_female
fields.title: Hybrid female (A) line
fields.description: Reserved for the female (cytoplasmic male-sterile A) parent of a hybrid. It is empty in the current release: registration records do not publish hybrid parent lines, and where a source prints them they are kept in pedigree. Values: Empty in every row.

fields.name: hybrid_parent_male
fields.title: Hybrid male (R) line
fields.description: Reserved for the male (restorer) parent of a hybrid. It is empty in the current release for the reason given under hybrid_parent_female. Values: Empty in every row.

fields.name: type
fields.title: Type as stated
fields.description: Variety type as written by the winning source. Capitalisation is not harmonised and a few rows are blank; rice_type is the cleaned version. Values: hybrid; inbred; Inbred; inbred (mutant).

fields.name: developer
fields.title: Developer as printed
fields.description: Name of the developing institute or the applicant company as printed by the winning source, in Bangla or English. The same developer is written in many ways (148 spellings); use developer_std for grouping. Values: Free text as printed.

fields.name: developer_division
fields.title: Breeding division
fields.description: Breeding division of the developing institute, where an institute page or the author affiliation of the key paper names it. It is a medium-confidence attribution, not an official statement of which division bred the variety. Values: Plant Breeding Division, BRRI; Plant Breeding Division, BINA.

fields.name: origin_country
fields.title: Origin country as recorded
fields.description: Country of origin of the variety or its seed as recorded by the winning source, with any correction the source itself records. developer_country_of_origin is the cleaned version. Values: Mostly China, India, Bangladesh, Philippines (IRRI); a few cells carry the correction text, e.g. 'China (as corrected by NSB 91; NSB 90 printed ...)'.

fields.name: origin_statement
fields.title: Origin statements
fields.description: Statements of origin found in the pedigree slot of a source (for example 'origin India', 'imported from China'), kept separately because they describe where seed came from, not parentage. Values: Statements separated by ' | '.

fields.name: trial_codes
fields.title: SCA trial codes
fields.description: Seed Certification Agency trial entry numbers of a hybrid (for example 'H-101/127'), found in the pedigree or breeding-line slot of a source. They identify the entry in the SCA's VCU trials and are not pedigrees. Values: Codes separated by ' | ' (several trial years may be listed).

fields.name: pedigree_note
fields.title: Pedigree note
fields.description: Text found in the pedigree slot that is not a pedigree: 'own development', a trade name, a supplier, or a trait. Kept so that nothing printed is lost. Values: Notes separated by ' | '.

fields.name: release_category
fields.title: Approval route
fields.description: Approval route. It is blank for every row of this table by construction: a name is placed here precisely because no eligible evidence records an approval event. Values: Blank.

fields.name: approving_body
fields.title: Approving body
fields.description: Body that approved the variety, as the sources describe it. For varieties released after 1977 the NSB approves and the Ministry of Agriculture notifies the release in the Gazette. Values: Mostly 'NSB' or 'NSB (approval); Government/MoA (notification)'; some rows name the Technical Committee meeting that recommended the variety; 'none: recommended before the NSB was constituted (1974)' for pre-NSB varieties.

fields.name: approval_date
fields.title: Date of recorded event
fields.description: Date or year of the event that the sources do record for the name (for example the year an institute lists it, or the NSB meeting that refused it). It is not an approval date. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or year only.

fields.name: approval_reference
fields.title: NSB meeting and agenda item
fields.description: Meeting number and agenda item of the National Seed Board decision behind approval_date. Values: 'NSB <n>th meeting, agenda <k>' (agenda omitted where the source does not give it).

fields.name: provisional_release_date
fields.title: Provisional release date
fields.description: Date of an earlier provisional release by the NSB, for varieties whose full release came later (BRRI dhan40 and BRRI dhan41). Blank for all other varieties. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: provisional_release_reference
fields.title: Provisional release reference
fields.description: NSB meeting and agenda item of the provisional release. Values: 'NSB <n>th meeting, agenda <k>'.

fields.name: gazette_date
fields.title: Gazette notification date
fields.description: Date of the earliest Bangladesh Gazette notification of the release that was found in an archived copy of the Gazette. Later notifications of the same variety are listed in conflict_note. Blank means no archived gazette copy was found; see gazette_status for the reason. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: gazette_date_reported
fields.title: Gazette date reported in NSB minutes
fields.description: Gazette notification date as reported in later NSB minutes when no copy of that Gazette issue was found. It is a report of a notification, not a copy of one. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: gazette_status_note
fields.title: Gazette status note
fields.description: What the NSB minutes or Seed Wing memos say about the gazetting of the variety when no gazette copy was found (sent for gazetting, not yet published at the next meeting, reported issued between two dates). Values: Free text, partly Bangla, with memo numbers as printed.

fields.name: gazette_reference
fields.title: Gazette reference
fields.description: Issue, date and pages of the Gazette notification in gazette_date, with the Seed Wing notification number. Values: Free text, e.g. 'Bangladesh Gazette Extraordinary 2013-12-02, p.10261-10262; MoA Seed Wing ...'.

fields.name: season
fields.title: Season as stated
fields.description: Growing season or seasons for which the variety was approved, in English labels as given by the winning source. Bangladesh has three rice seasons: Aus (pre-monsoon), Aman (monsoon) and Boro (dry, irrigated). For analysis use season_std or the three season flags, which also read season statements in other columns. Values: Aus; Aman; T. Aman; Boro; combinations joined by '; '; qualifiers such as '(direct-seeded)'.

fields.name: ecosystem
fields.title: Ecosystem as printed
fields.description: Land type or rice ecosystem for which the variety is recommended, as printed. Most entries are Bangla land-elevation classes (উঁচু, মধ্যম উঁচু, নিচু জমি: high, medium-high, low land) rather than rice ecosystems. Values: Free text, mostly Bangla.

fields.name: region_scope
fields.title: Approved region (summary)
fields.description: Region for which the variety was approved, as summarised in English by the extracting agent from the NSB decision or official list. Hybrid registrations name SCA trial regions after their headquarters towns, in the source's spelling (Comilla, Jessore, Rajshahi). Values: 'nationwide', 'Whole country', or a comma-separated list of regions.

fields.name: duration_days
fields.title: Growth duration as printed
fields.description: Growth duration from seeding to maturity, in days, as printed. A cell may hold a range, several season-specific values or condition-specific values, so it is text; use duration_min_days and duration_max_days for numbers. Values: Days; free text such as '140-145', '130-135 (আউশ); 150-155 (বোরো)'.

fields.name: yield_t_ha
fields.title: Yield as printed
fields.description: Yield in tonnes per hectare as printed by the winning source (usually the average yield in trials or the yield the institute advertises). The cell may hold a range or season-specific values, so it is text. Values: t/ha; free text.

fields.name: yield_source_id
fields.title: Source of the yield figure
fields.description: As in bgd_rice_varieties.csv. Values: Source ids.

fields.name: yield_criterion_pct
fields.title: Yield criterion over check (%)
fields.description: As in bgd_rice_varieties.csv (renamed from yield_advantage_pct in v1.2). Values: Percent; a number, sometimes with a qualifier such as '10 (at 6 of 10 sites)' or '20 (vs BRRI dhan28)'.

fields.name: check_variety
fields.title: Check variety
fields.description: Variety used as the check (control) in the VCU trials named in the NSB decision, as printed. Values: Free text, mostly Bangla, sometimes with the check's yield.

fields.name: recommended_region
fields.title: Recommended region as printed
fields.description: Region or area for which the variety is recommended, as printed (mostly Bangla). Use region_divisions and region_nationwide for analysis. Values: Free text, mostly Bangla.

fields.name: release_year_official
fields.title: Release year in official list
fields.description: Release year printed in an official variety list (SCA compendium or annual list). It can differ from approval_year by a year because lists sometimes record the season of first cultivation or the year of printing. Values: Four-digit year.

fields.name: special_traits_official
fields.title: Special traits (official)
fields.description: Special characteristics of the variety as printed in official lists and NSB minutes, verbatim (mostly Bangla). Values: Free text; several sources separated by ' | '.

fields.name: identifying_traits_official
fields.title: Identifying traits (official)
fields.description: Identifying (distinguishing) characteristics as printed in the official lists, verbatim (mostly Bangla), for example grain shape and colour. Values: Free text; several sources separated by ' | '.

fields.name: quality_traits
fields.title: Grain quality measurements
fields.description: Grain quality values stated in the NSB minutes or institute sources, written as key=value pairs. Values: Keys: grain_type (as printed, Bangla), amylose_pct (percent), grain_wt_1000_g (grams per 1000 grains), protein_pct (percent), zinc_mg_kg and iron_mg_kg (mg/kg), lb_ratio (length-breadth ratio); pairs joined by '; ', sources by ' | '.

fields.name: stress_tolerance
fields.title: Stress tolerance statements
fields.description: Statements of tolerance to abiotic stress or resistance to disease and pests, verbatim (mostly Bangla). Values: Free text; several sources separated by ' | '.

fields.name: dus_result
fields.title: DUS test result
fields.description: Result of the Distinctness, Uniformity and Stability test as described in the NSB minutes (number of years, traits on which the variety differs from the check). Values: Free text, Bangla and English.

fields.name: vcu_sites
fields.title: Number of VCU trial sites
fields.description: Number of sites in the Value for Cultivation and Use trials reported in the NSB decision. Values: Integer count, occasionally with a qualifier such as '10 (2023-24 re-trial); 6 (2022-23)'.

fields.name: decision_conditions
fields.title: Conditions of approval
fields.description: Conditions attached to the NSB decision, verbatim in Bangla: provisional periods, seed import limits, labelling requirements, re-trial requirements. Values: Free text; several decisions separated by ' | '.

fields.name: key_traits
fields.title: Key traits (summary)
fields.description: Summary of the variety's key traits from all sources, in English or Bangla, typically duration, yield and notable tolerances, together with CGIAR screening codes where TRIVSA reports them. Values: Free text; one entry per source separated by ' | '.

fields.name: adoption
fields.title: Adoption as reported
fields.description: Adoption figures as reported by TRIVSA/ASTI, SPIA or study-area papers, each with its scope, reference period and method stated in the text. Figures from different sources measure different things (national area share by expert opinion, household survey shares in a sample) and are not comparable without reading the scope. Values: Free text; one entry per source separated by ' | '.

fields.name: market_segment
fields.title: GloMIP market segment
fields.description: CGIAR Global Market Intelligence Platform (GloMIP) market segment to which the variety is assigned. A segment groups many varieties and can contradict the variety's own season or ecosystem, so it is not used to derive covariates. Values: '<segment id> | <crop> | <hybrid status> | <region> | <use; grain> | ...' as printed by GloMIP.

fields.name: product_profile
fields.title: GloMIP product profile
fields.description: GloMIP product profile of the individual variety: recommended planting methods and ecosystems (PTR, DSR, irrigated lowland, rainfed lowland, upland), the varieties it is meant to replace or accompany, and its key strengths. Values: Free text as printed by GloMIP, ';'-separated attributes.

fields.name: status
fields.title: Status as stated
fields.description: Status stated by a source (for example 'withdrawn'). Values: Free text code.

fields.name: doi_key_paper
fields.title: DOI of key paper
fields.description: DOI of the release or description paper, or the main reference, for the variety. Blank means no such paper was found; it does not mean the variety is unpublished. Values: DOI without the https://doi.org/ prefix; several DOIs separated by ' | '.

fields.name: cgiar_role
fields.title: CGIAR involvement code
fields.description: Strongest documented link between the variety and CGIAR research, coded 1 to 5. The code describes documented links only: code 5 means no parentage or link is documented, which is the case for nearly all private hybrids, and it must not be read as 'no CGIAR involvement'. Values: 1 = CGIAR line released directly (or a mutant or selection within one); 2 = CGIAR line as parent or earlier ancestor, traced up to five generations (use depth_to_cgiar <= 2 for the SPIA parent-or-grandparent definition); 3 = CGIAR collaboration or funding only; 4 = pedigree known, no CGIAR element; 5 = unknown.

fields.name: cgiar_center
fields.title: CGIAR centre
fields.description: CGIAR centre named in the documented link. Blank for codes 4 and 5. Values: IRRI; AfricaRice; HarvestPlus.

fields.name: cgiar_lineage
fields.title: CGIAR link in words
