fields.description: Every documented CGIAR link written out, including weaker links than the one coded in cgiar_role (for example 'IRRI grandparent: IR20 via BR10' or 'pedigree known: Iratom-24 x Dular'). Values: Free text; links separated by ' | '.

fields.name: cgiar_evidence
fields.title: CGIAR evidence (summary)
fields.description: The quotation or table cell, as condensed by the extracting agent, that supports the CGIAR link coded in cgiar_role. Values: Free text, often Bangla.

fields.name: cgiar_evidence_quote
fields.title: CGIAR evidence (exact quote)
fields.description: Exact text of the source behind cgiar_evidence, in the original language, cut to 200 characters. Values: Free text, up to 200 characters.

fields.name: cgiar_evidence_source
fields.title: File and page of CGIAR evidence
fields.description: Archived file and page from which cgiar_evidence was taken. Values: '02_raw/<path>, p. <n>'.

fields.name: cgiar_evidence_url
fields.title: URL of CGIAR evidence
fields.description: Original public address of the document behind cgiar_evidence. Blank when cgiar_evidence is blank. Values: Absolute URL.

fields.name: cgiar_spia_flags
fields.title: SPIA 2025 CGIAR flags
fields.description: Flags from SPIA's Bangladesh Study 2025, Appendix B Table 27, kept separate from cgiar_role because SPIA's definition (IRRI parents or grandparents) differs from the register's code. Values: 'spia_direct', 'spia_indirect' or 'spia_none', then ' | SPIA T27 flags: ' and Y/N values for irri_direct, indirect_ir_parent, inger_entry, in_reference_library, sub1, saline_tolerance, drought_tolerance, harvestplus, followed by the IRRI/INGER designation text as printed.

fields.name: cgiar_independent
fields.title: CGIAR sources' own statements
fields.description: What CGIAR's own publications and websites say about the variety's origin (Dikitanan et al. 2022, Villanueva et al. 2022, Raitzer et al. 2015, Kretzschmar et al. 2018, CGSpace records, IRRI, HarvestPlus, STRASA, TRIVSA). It is a cross-check and is not used to set cgiar_role on its own. Values: Free text, '<source>: <statement>' entries separated by ' | '.

fields.name: cgiar_source_urls
fields.title: Links to CGIAR sources
fields.description: Links to every CGIAR-produced source that mentions the row (SPIA, IRRI, TRIVSA/ASTI, GloMIP, HarvestPlus, CGSpace, WorldFish, CGIAR papers). These sources are a cross-check and are not the basis of the approval record. Values: URLs separated by ' | '. Europe PMC and Springer supplement addresses are replaced by the article's DOI or landing page.

fields.name: source_url
fields.title: Original URL of main source
fields.description: Web address from which the main source file of the row was downloaded. For the rice register this is the file that supplied the approval record (approval_date); for other tables it is the file that supplied the row. Values: Absolute http(s) URL. Many Government of Bangladesh files are served from an Oracle object-storage address rather than a portal page; that is the address the portal links to.

fields.name: archived_url
fields.title: Wayback Machine copy
fields.description: Address of a copy of the same file in the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine, so that the source can be consulted if the original address changes. Blank means no archived copy was made or found; it does not mean the original is unavailable. Values: https://web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>/<original URL>.

fields.name: local_file
fields.title: Archived file
fields.description: Path of the source file inside the archive, relative to the archive root. Every value in the archive can be traced to a page of a file under 02_raw/. Values: Relative path beginning '02_raw/'; the SHA-256 of each file is in bgd_sources.csv.

fields.name: source_type
fields.title: Authority rank of main source
fields.description: Authority rank of the source that supplied the row's main date. The rank decides which value wins when sources disagree. Values: 1_primary_legal (NSB minutes, Bangladesh Gazette notifications, acts and rules); 2_official_list (SCA and MoA variety lists); 3_institute_page (BRRI, BINA, BFRI and university web pages, handbooks and fact sheets); 4_cgiar_record (CGIAR, IRRI, SPIA, HarvestPlus, WorldFish, ASTI/TRIVSA, GloMIP records); 5_peer_reviewed; 6_secondary (preprints, news, grey literature); 7_reviewer_synthesis (a value added by a reviewer with the file and page cited in the notes).

fields.name: retrieved_at
fields.title: Download date
fields.description: Date on which the main source file was downloaded or the bibliographic record was retrieved. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: n_sources
fields.title: Number of sources
fields.description: Number of distinct source documents that supplied at least one usable (eligible) value for the row. It measures how well documented a row is, not how many sources agree. Values: Count, 1 or more.

fields.name: validation_summary
fields.title: How key values were verified
fields.description: Summary of how the key values of the row were checked, written as field=check (extraction method) and separated by '; '. The fields reported are approval_date, breeding_line, gazette_date and cgiar_role when present. Values: Checks: key_check (a date or number matched the validated NSB meeting-date key); visual_check (read by eye on the page image or a crop of it); two_source (two independent sources give the same value); unvalidated (machine-readable text or OCR not checked by eye). 'text' means the value came from a machine-readable text layer and needed no check. Methods: html; pdf_text (the PDF's own Unicode text layer); bijoy2unicode (a legacy SutonnyMJ/Bijoy text layer converted to Unicode); api_json; xlsx; ocr (Tesseract 5 OCR of a 300-dpi render); visual_check (transcribed by eye from the page image).

fields.name: flags
fields.title: Quality flags
fields.description: Machine-readable quality flags for the row, separated by ';'. A flag marks something an analyst should know before using the row; the absence of flags does not certify a value. Values: year_only (only the year of the date is documented); date_single_source (one source, not cross-checked); has_conflicts:<fields> (sources disagree on a substantive field); <field>_unvalidated_only (the field had only unvalidated OCR values, which never enter the register, so it is blank); unvalidated_values=<n> (number of such values set aside); breeding_line_not_a_code_moved (descriptive text moved out of breeding_line); institute_claim_only (no official evidence); cgiar_role_default_unknown_no_pedigree, cgiar_role_5_pedigree_needs_review, cgiar_role_4_pedigree_documented_no_cgiar_element, cgiar_role_2_via_parent_variety, cgiar_center_missing (how cgiar_role was set); planned_not_released (fish).

fields.name: conflict_fields
fields.title: Fields in dispute
fields.description: Substantive fields on which the sources for this row disagree, separated by '; '. Only approval_date, gazette_date, breeding_line, pedigree, release_category, origin_country, release_date, generation and approval_or_release_mechanism are considered substantive. Blank means no substantive disagreement was found among eligible values. Values: Field names separated by '; '.

fields.name: conflict_note
fields.title: Disagreement summary
fields.description: One short note per field on which sources disagree, of the form '<field>: chose <value>; also <other value> (<source_id>)', with notes for different fields separated by ' | '. It covers every field, including formatting differences, and is a pointer to bgd_conflicts.csv, which holds every version with its file and page. Values: Free text; notes separated by ' | '. Later gazette notifications are listed as 'later gazette(s): <dates>'.

fields.name: notes
fields.title: Notes
fields.description: Free-text notes added by the coordinator or reviewers about the row, such as a CGIAR record that was checked and not used. Values: Free text; blank for most rows.

fields.name: gazette_status
fields.title: Gazette status
fields.description: Gazette situation of every variety, stated explicitly so that a blank gazette_date can be interpreted. Hybrid registrations are not gazetted, and no weekly Gazette issues before 2013 are online, so a missing gazette date before 2013 is usually a gap in the archive, not evidence that no notification was made. Values: notified (gazette in archive); notified per NSB minutes (gazette copy not found); notified per NSB minutes (date not stated); sent to Government Press, publication not confirmed; not gazetted (hybrid registrations are not gazetted); not applicable (before the Seeds Ordinance 1977); not yet published (gazettes checked to 1 Oct 2026); not found (dpp.gov.bd holds no weekly gazettes before 2013).

fields.name: source_url_status
fields.title: Link status of source_url
fields.description: Result of the most recent automated check of the address in source_url. A status other than ok does not mean the archived copy is missing: the file itself is kept under 02_raw/. Values: ok; blocked_to_bots (HTTP 403: the page exists but refuses automated checks); dead (404, 410 or a soft error page); unreachable (DNS, TLS or timeout failure); unchecked. Blank when the link column is blank.

fields.name: archived_url_status
fields.title: Link status of archived_url
fields.description: Result of the most recent automated check of the address in archived_url. A status other than ok does not mean the archived copy is missing: the file itself is kept under 02_raw/. Values: ok; blocked_to_bots (HTTP 403: the page exists but refuses automated checks); dead (404, 410 or a soft error page); unreachable (DNS, TLS or timeout failure); unchecked. Blank when the link column is blank.

resources.name: bgd_rice_varieties
resources.title: One officially approved rice variety
resources.description: The register of rice varieties approved in Bangladesh: every variety released or registered by the National Seed Board (NSB) from its first meeting in 1974 to meeting 115 (5 February 2026), and the few varieties recommended before the Board existed. Each row gives the variety's names, developer, approval route and NSB decision, gazette notification, pedigree, agronomic traits, documented CGIAR link with its evidence, legal status in 2026, and the main source with quality flags. Values are chosen from long-format evidence by field-specific precedence rules; every competing value is kept in bgd_conflicts.csv. Columns after the source columns are derived in English for analysis (scripts/derive_covariates.py, feature_tags.py) or copied from the pedigree and status tables.

fields.name: variety_id
fields.title: Variety identifier
fields.description: Stable identifier of a rice variety in the register and the key for joining every table in the archive. The number inside the identifier is the official series number of the variety, not a running count. Values: 'RICE-' followed by a key built from the official name by lib_keys.make_key: BR<n> (BR series, 1970-1993), BRRI_DHAN<n>, BRRI_HYBRID<n>, BINADHAN<n>, IRATOM<n>, BINASHAIL, BU_, BAU_ and GAU_ (universities), BRAC_DHAN<n>, PVT_ (other private inbreds), HYB_<trade name> (private and BADC hybrids), IR<n> and OLD_ (pre-BRRI introductions and old names).

fields.name: variety_name
fields.title: Display name
fields.description: Uniform English display name of the variety, generated from the identifier so that every variety is written the same way (for example 'BRRI dhan29', 'Binadhan-7', 'BRRI hybrid dhan1'). It is intended for display and labelling; the spellings used by the official documents are kept in official_name_en and official_name_bn. Values: Free text; for private hybrids the registration or trial code is added in parentheses where one is known, e.g. 'Partex hybrid dhan6 (HR-30)'. Unique within the register.

fields.name: developer_group
fields.title: Developer group
fields.description: Broad group of the developer, derived from the identifier. It separates the two public institutes from universities, the public seed corporation, private companies and the varieties introduced before BRRI existed. Values: BRRI; BINA; University; Private or NGO inbred; Private company; BADC (public corporation); Introduction (pre-BRRI); Other.

fields.name: sector
fields.title: Public or private
fields.description: Whether the developer is a public body or a private firm or NGO. The sector is independent of rice_type: BRRI and BADC hybrids are public hybrids, and BRAC's inbreds are private inbreds. Values: public; private.

fields.name: rice_type
fields.title: Hybrid or inbred
fields.description: Whether the variety is an F1 hybrid or an inbred (open-pollinated) variety. Use this column rather than type for analysis. Values: hybrid; inbred. Never blank.

fields.name: approval_year
fields.title: Approval year
fields.description: Calendar year of approval_date, the year of the National Seed Board decision that released or registered the variety (or the year of recommendation for the pre-NSB varieties). It is not the year of gazette notification or of first cultivation. Values: Four-digit year, 1966-2026.

fields.name: official_name_en
fields.title: Official English name
fields.description: English name of the variety as printed by the developing institute or another official source, with the source's own spacing and hyphenation (for example 'BAU dhan 2'). Blank means no English spelling was printed; most such rows are private hybrids registered under a Bangla name. Values: Free text as printed.

fields.name: official_name_bn
fields.title: Official Bangla name
fields.description: Bangla name of the variety as printed in the official record, kept exactly as printed, including Bangla digits and the source's own spacing and hyphens (for example 'বিনা ধান-১০'). Values: Bangla text (Unicode, NFC as extracted). Never blank in the register.

fields.name: popular_name
fields.title: Popular name
fields.description: Popular or farmer name given by an official or institute source (for example চান্দিনা for BR1). Blank means no source states one; other names reported by surveys and markets are in bgd_local_names.csv. Values: Free text, usually Bangla.

fields.name: aliases
fields.title: Other labels
fields.description: Other labels under which the variety appears in the sources: breeding-line labels that are not line codes (such as 'BR11-Sub1'), names used before renaming, trade names and codes printed by other sources. It is a record of labels seen in the sources, not a vetted list of local names. Values: Labels separated by ' | ', in order of first appearance.

fields.name: breeding_line
fields.title: Breeding line
fields.description: Pre-release designation of the line that became the variety (for example 'BR7671-37-2-2-3-7-3', 'IR91820-25BAY2-3-1'); for private hybrids, the company's trial or product code (for example 'Win301'). Blank means no line code was published. Values: Designation as printed. Where a source prints the code in both Bangla and Latin script the two forms are joined by '|' without spaces (for example 'বাউ-১৬|BAU-16').

fields.name: pedigree
fields.title: Pedigree (parentage)
fields.description: Parentage of the variety as printed, usually in Purdy notation ('/' a first-order cross, '//' a second-order cross, 'A*n/B' a backcross), or a statement of derivation such as 'mutant of BRRI dhan29' or 'line collected from IRRI, Philippines'. Blank means no pedigree has been published, which is the case for most private hybrids; it does not mean the variety has no known parents. Values: Free text as printed. Parsed parent-child links are in bgd_pedigree_edges.csv.

fields.name: hybrid_parent_female
fields.title: Hybrid female (A) line
fields.description: Reserved for the female (cytoplasmic male-sterile A) parent of a hybrid. It is empty in the current release: registration records do not publish hybrid parent lines, and where a source prints them they are kept in pedigree. Values: Empty in every row.

fields.name: hybrid_parent_male
fields.title: Hybrid male (R) line
fields.description: Reserved for the male (restorer) parent of a hybrid. It is empty in the current release for the reason given under hybrid_parent_female. Values: Empty in every row.

fields.name: type
fields.title: Type as stated
fields.description: Variety type as written by the winning source. Capitalisation is not harmonised and a few rows are blank; rice_type is the cleaned version. Values: hybrid; inbred; Inbred; inbred (mutant).

fields.name: developer
fields.title: Developer as printed
fields.description: Name of the developing institute or the applicant company as printed by the winning source, in Bangla or English. The same developer is written in many ways (148 spellings); use developer_std for grouping. Values: Free text as printed.

fields.name: developer_std
fields.title: Developer (standardised)
fields.description: Canonical English name of the developer or applicant. Bangla names and spelling variants map to one name; legally separate firms of one business group stay separate (ACI Limited, ACI Formulations, ACI Agrolink), and Gazipur Agricultural University is coded under its former name BSMRAU. Values: Names from the DEVELOPERS table in derive_covariates.py (e.g. BRRI, BINA, BAU, BSMRAU, BADC, BRAC, Supreme Seed Company); a name not in the table falls back to the cleaned original with legal suffixes removed. The pre-BRRI introductions are coded by breeding institution: IRRI (IR5, IR8, IR20), 'introduction (Malaysia)' (Pajam), 'introduction (China)' (Purbachi).

fields.name: developer_type
fields.title: Developer type
fields.description: Institutional type of the standardised developer. Values: public research institute (BRRI, BINA); university; public seed agency (BADC); NGO (BRAC and its seed enterprise); foreign public (IRRI: IR5, IR8, IR20); introduction (Pajam, Purbachi); private company.

fields.name: developer_country_of_origin
fields.title: Country of germplasm origin
fields.description: Country from which the seed or germplasm came, as recorded in the register (mostly the import origin of hybrids stated in the NSB minutes). It is never inferred from the nationality of the company. Blank means not stated, which is the usual case for public inbreds. Values: China; India; Bangladesh; Philippines (IRRI); Vietnam; 'Bangladesh; China'.

fields.name: developer_division
fields.title: Breeding division
fields.description: Breeding division of the developing institute, where an institute page or the author affiliation of the key paper names it. It is a medium-confidence attribution, not an official statement of which division bred the variety. Values: Plant Breeding Division, BRRI; Plant Breeding Division, BINA.

fields.name: origin_country
fields.title: Origin country as recorded
fields.description: Country of origin of the variety or its seed as recorded by the winning source, with any correction the source itself records. developer_country_of_origin is the cleaned version. Values: Country names (China, India, Bangladesh, Philippines, Vietnam); IRRI as 'Philippines (IRRI)'; two origins as 'China; Bangladesh'. Correction notes printed by the NSB are in notes since v1.2.

fields.name: origin_statement
fields.title: Origin statements
fields.description: Statements of origin found in the pedigree slot of a source (for example 'origin India', 'imported from China'), kept separately because they describe where seed came from, not parentage. Values: Statements separated by ' | '.

fields.name: trial_codes
fields.title: SCA trial codes
fields.description: Seed Certification Agency trial entry numbers of a hybrid (for example 'H-101/127'), found in the pedigree or breeding-line slot of a source. They identify the entry in the SCA's VCU trials and are not pedigrees. Values: Codes separated by ' | ' (several trial years may be listed).

fields.name: pedigree_note
fields.title: Pedigree note
fields.description: Text found in the pedigree slot that is not a pedigree: 'own development', a trade name, a supplier, or a trait. Kept so that nothing printed is lost. Values: Notes separated by ' | '.

fields.name: breeding_method
fields.title: Breeding method
fields.description: How the variety was developed, read from the pedigree text. Several methods can apply (for example a cross followed by marker-assisted backcrossing). Blank means the pedigree is empty or names a single parent without saying how it was used. Values: introduction; selection; cross; mutation; somaclonal; biotech; hybrid (CMS 3-line); hybrid (2-line); hybrid (system not stated); joined by '; '. 'introduction' and the hybrid values are exclusive.

fields.name: release_category
fields.title: Approval route
fields.description: Legal route by which the variety was approved. Release (ছাড়করণ) applies to inbred varieties and some public hybrids; registration (নিবন্ধন) is the route for hybrids, which since 1998 are registered after VCU trials rather than released. A row is in the register only if this field is filled. Values: NSB_release; NSB_registration; pre_NSB_recommended (recommended 1966-1973, before the National Seed Board was constituted).

fields.name: approving_body
fields.title: Approving body
fields.description: Body that approved the variety, as the sources describe it. For varieties released after 1977 the NSB approves and the Ministry of Agriculture notifies the release in the Gazette. Values: Mostly 'NSB' or 'NSB (approval); Government/MoA (notification)'; some rows name the Technical Committee meeting that recommended the variety; 'none: recommended before the NSB was constituted (1974)' for pre-NSB varieties.

fields.name: approval_date
fields.title: Approval date (NSB decision)
fields.description: Date of the National Seed Board meeting that released or registered the variety. For the pre-NSB varieties it is the date or year of the recommendation. An earlier provisional release is in provisional_release_date, and later decisions (extensions, renamings, suspensions) are in bgd_variety_events.csv. This is a decision date, not the gazette date, the date of first sale or the date of first cultivation. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; year only (YYYY) when only the year is documented, which affects 12 rows (flag year_only).

fields.name: approval_reference
fields.title: NSB meeting and agenda item
fields.description: Meeting number and agenda item of the National Seed Board decision behind approval_date. Values: 'NSB <n>th meeting, agenda <k>' (agenda omitted where the source does not give it).

fields.name: provisional_release_date
fields.title: Provisional release date
fields.description: Date of an earlier provisional release by the NSB, for varieties whose full release came later (BRRI dhan40 and BRRI dhan41). Blank for all other varieties. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: provisional_release_reference
fields.title: Provisional release reference
fields.description: NSB meeting and agenda item of the provisional release. Values: 'NSB <n>th meeting, agenda <k>'.

fields.name: gazette_date
fields.title: Gazette notification date
fields.description: Date of the earliest Bangladesh Gazette notification of the release that was found in an archived copy of the Gazette. Later notifications of the same variety are listed in conflict_note. Blank means no archived gazette copy was found; see gazette_status for the reason. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: gazette_date_reported
fields.title: Gazette date reported in NSB minutes
fields.description: Gazette notification date as reported in later NSB minutes when no copy of that Gazette issue was found. It is a report of a notification, not a copy of one. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: gazette_status_note
fields.title: Gazette status note
fields.description: What the NSB minutes or Seed Wing memos say about the gazetting of the variety when no gazette copy was found (sent for gazetting, not yet published at the next meeting, reported issued between two dates). Values: Free text, partly Bangla, with memo numbers as printed.

fields.name: gazette_reference
fields.title: Gazette reference
fields.description: Issue, date and pages of the Gazette notification in gazette_date, with the Seed Wing notification number. Values: Free text, e.g. 'Bangladesh Gazette Extraordinary 2013-12-02, p.10261-10262; MoA Seed Wing ...'.

fields.name: season
fields.title: Season as stated
fields.description: Growing season or seasons for which the variety was approved, in English labels as given by the winning source. Bangladesh has three rice seasons: Aus (pre-monsoon), Aman (monsoon) and Boro (dry, irrigated). For analysis use season_std or the three season flags, which also read season statements in other columns. Values: Aus; Aman; T. Aman; Boro; combinations joined by '; '; qualifiers such as '(direct-seeded)'.

fields.name: season_aus
fields.title: Aus season flag
fields.description: 1 when any source in the register names Aus as a season for the variety. When at least one season is known, the seasons not named are 0. Blank only when no season is stated anywhere. Values: 1; 0; blank (not stated).

fields.name: season_aman
fields.title: Aman season flag
fields.description: As season_aus, for the Aman (monsoon) season, including transplanted Aman (T. Aman). Values: 1; 0; blank (not stated).

fields.name: season_boro
fields.title: Boro season flag
fields.description: As season_aus, for the Boro (dry, irrigated) season. Values: 1; 0; blank (not stated).

fields.name: season_std
fields.title: Seasons (standardised)
fields.description: The seasons flagged 1, written in a fixed order. Values: Lower-case season names joined by '; ' in the order aus; aman; boro.

fields.name: ecosystem
fields.title: Ecosystem as printed
fields.description: Land type or rice ecosystem for which the variety is recommended, as printed. Most entries are Bangla land-elevation classes (উঁচু, মধ্যম উঁচু, নিচু জমি: high, medium-high, low land) rather than rice ecosystems. Values: Free text, mostly Bangla.

fields.name: ecosystem_std
fields.title: Rice ecosystem (standardised)
fields.description: Rice ecosystem stated for the variety. A category is assigned only when a source states it; no ecosystem is inferred from the season (Boro is irrigated in practice, but that inference is left to the analyst). Bangla 'উঁচু জমি' (high land) is a land-elevation class and is not coded as upland. Blank means not stated, which is the usual case for hybrids. Values: irrigated; rainfed lowland; upland; tidal; deepwater/haor; saline coastal; favourable; joined by '; '.

fields.name: ecosystem_text_en
fields.title: Ecosystem (English gloss)
fields.description: Short English gloss of the ecosystem column, keeping the land-elevation classes, with ecosystem phrases from the region text appended (tidal areas, haor areas, saline areas, flood-prone areas). Values: Free text, e.g. 'irrigated; high, medium-high and medium-low land'.

fields.name: establishment
fields.title: Crop establishment
fields.description: Crop establishment method stated for the variety: transplanting or direct seeding. Blank means not stated. Values: transplanted; direct-seeded; both.

fields.name: photoperiod
fields.title: Photoperiod response
fields.description: Whether a source states that the variety is photoperiod-sensitive or insensitive. Only explicit statements count; weakly or somewhat sensitive varieties are coded sensitive. Blank when not stated or when sources contradict each other. Values: sensitive; insensitive.

fields.name: region_scope
fields.title: Approved region (summary)
fields.description: Region for which the variety was approved, as summarised in English by the extracting agent from the NSB decision or official list. Hybrid registrations name SCA trial regions after their headquarters towns, in the source's spelling (Comilla, Jessore, Rajshahi). Values: 'nationwide', 'Whole country', or a comma-separated list of regions.

fields.name: duration_days
fields.title: Growth duration as printed
fields.description: Growth duration from seeding to maturity, in days, as printed. A cell may hold a range, several season-specific values or condition-specific values, so it is text; use duration_min_days and duration_max_days for numbers. Values: Days; free text such as '140-145', '130-135 (আউশ); 150-155 (বোরো)'.

fields.name: duration_min_days
fields.title: Growth duration, minimum
fields.description: Smallest duration in days among all values in duration_days, including season- and condition-specific values. Values: Days, 60-220. Blank when duration_days is blank or unreadable.

fields.name: duration_max_days
fields.title: Growth duration, maximum
fields.description: Largest duration in days among all values in duration_days. Values: Days, 60-220.

fields.name: duration_by_season
fields.title: Growth duration by season
fields.description: Season-specific durations, filled only when a value in duration_days carries a season label. Values: 'season=min-max' pairs joined by '; ', e.g. 'aus=130-135; boro=150-155'. Days.

fields.name: yield_t_ha
fields.title: Yield as printed
fields.description: Yield in tonnes per hectare as printed by the winning source (usually the average yield in trials or the yield the institute advertises). The cell may hold a range or season-specific values, so it is text. Values: t/ha as text; unit words printed in the source ('টন/হেঃ', 'মে.টন') are removed in v1.2; a per-acre figure keeps its text.

fields.name: yield_min_t_ha
fields.title: Yield, minimum
fields.description: Smallest yield among all values in yield_t_ha. Values: Tonnes per hectare, 1.5-15.

fields.name: yield_max_t_ha
fields.title: Yield, maximum
fields.description: Largest yield among all values in yield_t_ha. Values: Tonnes per hectare, 1.5-15.

fields.name: yield_by_season
fields.title: Yield by season
fields.description: Season-specific yields, filled only when a value in yield_t_ha carries a season label. Values: 'season=min-max' pairs joined by '; ', in t/ha.

fields.name: yield_basis
fields.title: Basis of the yield figure
fields.description: What the yield figure in yield_t_ha is, judged from the source that supplied it. NSB decisions give the mean of the Board's multi-location trials; institute fact sheets give an average or potential yield as advertised. Yields of different bases, and in practice yields of hybrids and inbreds, are not comparable. Values: NSB trial mean; official list (SCA annual list, compendium or MoA hybrid list); gazette notice; institute (advertised); other; blank when yield_t_ha is blank.

fields.name: yield_source_id
fields.title: Source of the yield figure
fields.description: Source identifier of the evidence row whose value is in yield_t_ha (see bgd_sources.csv and the evidence tables). Values: Source ids such as NSB_111, SCA_FY2023-24_INBRED, GZ_2025-07-19, RB-S01.

fields.name: yield_criterion_pct
fields.title: Yield criterion over check (%)
fields.description: Minimum yield advantage over the check variety, in percent, that the NSB decision says the variety met (renamed from yield_advantage_pct in version 1.2). For hybrid registrations it is the registration criterion (20 percent over the check in most decisions, 5 percent against a hybrid check in recent ones); for inbreds it records how many trial sites showed a 10 percent advantage. It is a criterion, not a measured yield gain. Values: Percent, sometimes with a qualifier such as '10 (at 6 of 10 sites)' or '20 (vs BRRI dhan28)'.

fields.name: check_variety
fields.title: Check variety
fields.description: Variety used as the check (control) in the VCU trials named in the NSB decision, as printed. Values: Free text, mostly Bangla, sometimes with the check's yield.

fields.name: recommended_region
fields.title: Recommended region as printed
fields.description: Region or area for which the variety is recommended, as printed (mostly Bangla). Use region_divisions and region_nationwide for analysis. Values: Free text, mostly Bangla.

fields.name: region_divisions
fields.title: Approved divisions
fields.description: Administrative divisions (BBS, eight divisions with Mymensingh separate since 2015) covered by the approved or recommended region. For hybrid registrations the regions are SCA trial regions named after towns and are mapped through the town's district, so they should be read as trial-region approvals, not administrative boundaries. Blank when no place is named. Values: Division names joined by '; ' from Barishal; Chattogram; Dhaka; Khulna; Mymensingh; Rajshahi; Rangpur; Sylhet.

fields.name: region_nationwide
fields.title: Nationwide approval flag
fields.description: 1 when the approval covers the whole country with no division excepted; 0 when divisions, districts or target areas are named or a division is excepted ('except Khulna and Barisal'); blank when no place is named. Since v1.2 region_scope (from the approving decision) decides when it names a place. Values: 1; 0; blank (not stated).

fields.name: release_year_official
fields.title: Release year in official list
fields.description: Release year printed in an official variety list (SCA compendium or annual list). It can differ from approval_year by a year because lists sometimes record the season of first cultivation or the year of printing. Values: Four-digit year.

fields.name: special_traits_official
fields.title: Special traits (official)
fields.description: Special characteristics of the variety as printed in official lists and NSB minutes, verbatim (mostly Bangla). Values: Free text; several sources separated by ' | '.

fields.name: identifying_traits_official
fields.title: Identifying traits (official)
fields.description: Identifying (distinguishing) characteristics as printed in the official lists, verbatim (mostly Bangla), for example grain shape and colour. Values: Free text; several sources separated by ' | '.

fields.name: quality_traits
fields.title: Grain quality measurements
fields.description: Grain quality values stated in the NSB minutes or institute sources, written as key=value pairs. Values: Keys: grain_type (as printed, Bangla), amylose_pct (percent), grain_wt_1000_g (grams per 1000 grains), protein_pct (percent), zinc_mg_kg and iron_mg_kg (mg/kg), lb_ratio (length-breadth ratio); pairs joined by '; ', sources by ' | '.

fields.name: grain_class
fields.title: Grain class
fields.description: Grain length and shape class read from grain phrases only, so that plant height ('গাছ লম্বা', tall plant) never counts. A partial value is given when a source states only one dimension. Blank means not stated, which is the usual case for hybrids. Values: long slender; medium slender; short slender; long bold; medium bold; short bold; slender (length not stated); bold (length not stated); long (shape not stated); medium (shape not stated); short (shape not stated).

fields.name: stress_tolerance
fields.title: Stress tolerance statements
fields.description: Statements of tolerance to abiotic stress or resistance to disease and pests, verbatim (mostly Bangla). Values: Free text; several sources separated by ' | '.

fields.name: dus_result
fields.title: DUS test result
fields.description: Result of the Distinctness, Uniformity and Stability test as described in the NSB minutes (number of years, traits on which the variety differs from the check). Values: Free text, Bangla and English.

fields.name: vcu_sites
fields.title: Number of VCU trial sites
fields.description: Number of sites in the Value for Cultivation and Use trials reported in the NSB decision. Values: Integer count, occasionally with a qualifier such as '10 (2023-24 re-trial); 6 (2022-23)'.

fields.name: decision_conditions
fields.title: Conditions of approval
fields.description: Conditions attached to the NSB decision, verbatim in Bangla: provisional periods, seed import limits, labelling requirements, re-trial requirements. Values: Free text; several decisions separated by ' | '.

fields.name: feature_tags
fields.title: Feature tags
fields.description: Standardised English tags for the main traits of the variety, read from the trait text. The rules are strict: a stress tag needs a tolerance word next to the stress term, a resistance tag a resistance word, a negated clause never produces a tag, and 'short duration' is dropped when the stated duration exceeds 145 (Boro), 120 (Aman) or 110 (Aus) days. A blank cell means no tag was found in the available text; read it together with trait_text_available. Values: salt tolerant; submergence tolerant; drought tolerant; cold tolerant; heat tolerant; tidal / deepwater / haor; zinc enriched; high protein; aromatic; fine grain; short duration; blast resistant; bacterial blight resistant; lodging resistant; low glycemic index; joined by ' | '.

fields.name: feature_evidence
fields.title: Evidence for feature tags
fields.description: For each tag in feature_tags, the column or columns whose text produced it, so that every tag can be traced back. Values: '<tag>: <column>, <column>' entries joined by ' | '; '(TRIVSA screening)' marks a TRIVSA code and 'stated zinc content <n> mg/kg' a numeric zinc statement. Since v1.2 also entries for tags NOT given: '<tag>: SPIA only (cgiar_spia_flags), not tagged', '<tag>: not tagged, sources conflict (...)', '<tag>: not tagged, source text says susceptible (...)'.

fields.name: trait_text_available
fields.title: Trait text available
fields.description: Whether the register holds any trait text for the variety (official trait columns, quality, stress tolerance or key_traits). A blank feature_tags together with 'no' means there is no information, not that the variety lacks the traits. Values: yes; no.

fields.name: key_traits
fields.title: Key traits (summary)
fields.description: Summary of the variety's key traits from all sources, in English or Bangla, typically duration, yield and notable tolerances, together with CGIAR screening codes where TRIVSA reports them. Values: Free text; one entry per source separated by ' | '.

fields.name: adoption
fields.title: Adoption as reported
fields.description: Adoption figures as reported by TRIVSA/ASTI, SPIA or study-area papers, each with its scope, reference period and method stated in the text. Figures from different sources measure different things (national area share by expert opinion, household survey shares in a sample) and are not comparable without reading the scope. Values: Free text; one entry per source separated by ' | '.

fields.name: market_segment
fields.title: GloMIP market segment
fields.description: CGIAR Global Market Intelligence Platform (GloMIP) market segment to which the variety is assigned. A segment groups many varieties and can contradict the variety's own season or ecosystem, so it is not used to derive covariates. Values: '<segment id> | <crop> | <hybrid status> | <region> | <use; grain> | ...' as printed by GloMIP.

fields.name: product_profile
fields.title: GloMIP product profile
fields.description: GloMIP product profile of the individual variety: recommended planting methods and ecosystems (PTR, DSR, irrigated lowland, rainfed lowland, upland), the varieties it is meant to replace or accompany, and its key strengths. Values: Free text as printed by GloMIP, ';'-separated attributes.

fields.name: doi_key_paper
fields.title: DOI of key paper
fields.description: DOI of the release or description paper, or the main reference, for the variety. Blank means no such paper was found; it does not mean the variety is unpublished. Values: DOI without the https://doi.org/ prefix; several DOIs separated by ' | '.

fields.name: cgiar_role
fields.title: CGIAR involvement code
fields.description: Strongest documented link between the variety and CGIAR research, coded 1 to 5. The code describes documented links only: code 5 means no parentage or link is documented, which is the case for nearly all private hybrids, and it must not be read as 'no CGIAR involvement'. Values: 1 = CGIAR line released directly, including a mutant, somaclone or selection made directly from a CGIAR line (depth_to_cgiar 0); 2 = CGIAR parent or earlier ancestor (depth_to_cgiar >= 1), traced up to five generations (use depth_to_cgiar <= 2 for the SPIA parent-or-grandparent definition); 3 = CGIAR collaboration or funding only; 4 = pedigree known, no CGIAR element; 5 = unknown.

fields.name: cgiar_derivation
fields.title: How the variety descends from CGIAR germplasm
fields.description: The kind of CGIAR link behind cgiar_role, so that code 1 and code 2 can be split by breeding route. Values: direct line; selection; mutant/somaclone (code 1); cross with CGIAR parent (code 2, depth 1); ancestor (code 2, depth >= 2); collaboration (3); none (4); unknown (5).

fields.name: cgiar_center
fields.title: CGIAR centre
fields.description: CGIAR centre named in the documented link. Blank for codes 4 and 5. Values: IRRI; AfricaRice; HarvestPlus.

fields.name: cgiar_lineage
fields.title: CGIAR link in words
fields.description: Every documented CGIAR link written out, including weaker links than the one coded in cgiar_role (for example 'IRRI grandparent: IR20 via BR10' or 'pedigree known: Iratom-24 x Dular'). Values: Free text; links separated by ' | '.

fields.name: cgiar_evidence
fields.title: CGIAR evidence (summary)
fields.description: The quotation or table cell, as condensed by the extracting agent, that supports the CGIAR link coded in cgiar_role. Values: Free text, often Bangla.

fields.name: cgiar_evidence_quote
fields.title: CGIAR evidence (exact quote)
fields.description: Exact text of the source behind cgiar_evidence, in the original language, cut to 200 characters. Values: Free text, up to 200 characters.

fields.name: cgiar_evidence_source
fields.title: File and page of CGIAR evidence
fields.description: Archived file and page from which cgiar_evidence was taken. Values: '02_raw/<path>, p. <n>'.

fields.name: cgiar_evidence_url
fields.title: URL of CGIAR evidence
fields.description: Original public address of the document behind cgiar_evidence. Blank when cgiar_evidence is blank. Values: Absolute URL.

fields.name: cgiar_spia_flags
fields.title: SPIA 2025 CGIAR flags
fields.description: Flags from SPIA's Bangladesh Study 2025, Appendix B Table 27, kept separate from cgiar_role because SPIA's definition (IRRI parents or grandparents) differs from the register's code. Values: 'spia_direct', 'spia_indirect' or 'spia_none', then ' | SPIA T27 flags: ' and Y/N values for irri_direct, indirect_ir_parent, inger_entry, in_reference_library, sub1, saline_tolerance, drought_tolerance, harvestplus, followed by the IRRI/INGER designation text as printed.

fields.name: cgiar_independent
fields.title: CGIAR sources' own statements
fields.description: What CGIAR's own publications and websites say about the variety's origin (Dikitanan et al. 2022, Villanueva et al. 2022, Raitzer et al. 2015, Kretzschmar et al. 2018, CGSpace records, IRRI, HarvestPlus, STRASA, TRIVSA). It is a cross-check and is not used to set cgiar_role on its own. Values: Free text, '<source>: <statement>' entries separated by ' | '.

fields.name: cgiar_source_urls
fields.title: Links to CGIAR sources
fields.description: Links to every CGIAR-produced source that mentions the row (SPIA, IRRI, TRIVSA/ASTI, GloMIP, HarvestPlus, CGSpace, WorldFish, CGIAR papers). These sources are a cross-check and are not the basis of the approval record. Values: URLs separated by ' | '. Europe PMC and Springer supplement addresses are replaced by the article's DOI or landing page.

fields.name: source_url
fields.title: Original URL of main source
fields.description: Web address from which the main source file of the row was downloaded. For the rice register this is the file that supplied the approval record (approval_date); for other tables it is the file that supplied the row. Values: Absolute http(s) URL. Many Government of Bangladesh files are served from an Oracle object-storage address rather than a portal page; that is the address the portal links to.

fields.name: archived_url
fields.title: Wayback Machine copy
fields.description: Address of a copy of the same file in the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine, so that the source can be consulted if the original address changes. Blank means no archived copy was made or found; it does not mean the original is unavailable. Values: https://web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>/<original URL>.

fields.name: local_file
fields.title: Archived file
fields.description: Path of the source file inside the archive, relative to the archive root. Every value in the archive can be traced to a page of a file under 02_raw/. Values: Relative path beginning '02_raw/'; the SHA-256 of each file is in bgd_sources.csv.

fields.name: source_type
fields.title: Authority rank of main source
fields.description: Authority rank of the source that supplied the row's main date. The rank decides which value wins when sources disagree. Values: 1_primary_legal (NSB minutes, Bangladesh Gazette notifications, acts and rules); 2_official_list (SCA and MoA variety lists); 3_institute_page (BRRI, BINA, BFRI and university web pages, handbooks and fact sheets); 4_cgiar_record (CGIAR, IRRI, SPIA, HarvestPlus, WorldFish, ASTI/TRIVSA, GloMIP records); 5_peer_reviewed; 6_secondary (preprints, news, grey literature); 7_reviewer_synthesis (a value added by a reviewer with the file and page cited in the notes).

fields.name: retrieved_at
fields.title: Download date
fields.description: Date on which the main source file was downloaded or the bibliographic record was retrieved. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: n_sources
fields.title: Number of sources
fields.description: Number of distinct source documents that supplied at least one usable (eligible) value for the row. It measures how well documented a row is, not how many sources agree. Values: Count, 1 or more.

fields.name: validation_summary
fields.title: How key values were verified
fields.description: Summary of how the key values of the row were checked, written as field=check (extraction method) and separated by '; '. The fields reported are approval_date, breeding_line, gazette_date and cgiar_role when present. Values: Checks: key_check (a date or number matched the validated NSB meeting-date key); visual_check (read by eye on the page image or a crop of it); two_source (two independent sources give the same value); unvalidated (machine-readable text or OCR not checked by eye). 'text' means the value came from a machine-readable text layer and needed no check. Methods: html; pdf_text (the PDF's own Unicode text layer); bijoy2unicode (a legacy SutonnyMJ/Bijoy text layer converted to Unicode); api_json; xlsx; ocr (Tesseract 5 OCR of a 300-dpi render); visual_check (transcribed by eye from the page image).

fields.name: flags
fields.title: Quality flags
fields.description: Machine-readable quality flags for the row, separated by ';'. A flag marks something an analyst should know before using the row; the absence of flags does not certify a value. Values: year_only (only the year of the date is documented); date_single_source (one source, not cross-checked); has_conflicts:<fields> (sources disagree on a substantive field); <field>_unvalidated_only (the field had only unvalidated OCR values, which never enter the register, so it is blank); unvalidated_values=<n> (number of such values set aside); breeding_line_not_a_code_moved (descriptive text moved out of breeding_line); institute_claim_only (no official evidence); cgiar_role_default_unknown_no_pedigree, cgiar_role_5_pedigree_needs_review, cgiar_role_4_pedigree_documented_no_cgiar_element, cgiar_role_2_via_parent_variety, cgiar_center_missing (how cgiar_role was set); planned_not_released (fish).

fields.name: quality_notes
fields.title: Quality notes
fields.description: The flags of the row written out as sentences for readers: why the CGIAR code is what it is, which fields rest on readings that could not be confirmed and were left blank, where sources disagree. The machine-readable flags stay in flags. Values: Free text, one sentence per flag; blank when the row has no flag that needs explaining (unvalidated_values=<n> is not repeated).

fields.name: conflict_fields
fields.title: Fields in dispute
fields.description: Substantive fields on which the sources for this row disagree, separated by '; '. Only approval_date, gazette_date, breeding_line, pedigree, release_category, origin_country, release_date, generation and approval_or_release_mechanism are considered substantive. Blank means no substantive disagreement was found among eligible values. Values: Field names separated by '; '.

fields.name: conflict_note
fields.title: Disagreement summary
fields.description: One short note per field on which sources disagree, of the form '<field>: chose <value>; also <other value> (<source_id>)', with notes for different fields separated by ' | '. It covers every field, including formatting differences, and is a pointer to bgd_conflicts.csv, which holds every version with its file and page. Values: Free text; notes separated by ' | '. Later gazette notifications are listed as 'later gazette(s): <dates>'.

fields.name: notes
fields.title: Notes
fields.description: Free-text notes added by the coordinator or reviewers about the row, such as a CGIAR record that was checked and not used. Values: Free text; blank for most rows.

fields.name: gazette_status
fields.title: Gazette status
fields.description: Gazette situation of every variety, stated explicitly so that a blank gazette_date can be interpreted. Hybrid registrations are not gazetted, and no weekly Gazette issues before 2013 are online, so a missing gazette date before 2013 is usually a gap in the archive, not evidence that no notification was made. Values: notified (gazette in archive); notified per NSB minutes (gazette copy not found); notified per NSB minutes (date not stated); sent to Government Press, publication not confirmed; not gazetted (hybrid registrations are not gazetted); not applicable (before the Seeds Ordinance 1977); not yet published (gazettes checked to 1 Oct 2026); not found (dpp.gov.bd holds no weekly gazettes before 2013).

fields.name: status_as_of_2026
fields.title: Legal status, February 2026
fields.description: Legal status of the variety after the last NSB meeting in the archive (meeting 115, 5 February 2026). 'Active' is a legal status under the Seeds Ordinance and says nothing about whether seed is produced or sold. Status is never inferred from elapsed time; no registration is coded as expired. Kept for compatibility; legal_status_2026 states the same finding in words. Values: active; suspended; unknown (no NSB approval on record, a time-limited approval with no recorded renewal, or an approval made conditional with no recorded outcome); cancelled (defined, but no case found).

fields.name: legal_status_2026
fields.title: Legal status in words, February 2026
fields.description: Legal status after the last NSB meeting in the archive (meeting 115, 5 February 2026), in words. 'Active' means approved with no adverse decision on record; the 20 varieties the SCA proposed for denotification in 2021 are flagged. Legal status says nothing about whether seed is produced or the variety is grown. Values: active; active, withdrawal proposed 2021 and deferred; time-limited registration, renewal not recorded; provisional, re-evaluation outcome not recorded; seed multiplication suspended; suspended; recommended before the Board, no later decision; not approved (names outside the register, status file only).

fields.name: status_basis
fields.title: Basis of legal status
fields.description: Plain-English statement of the decision or absence of decisions behind status_as_of_2026, naming the meeting and date. Values: Free text.

fields.name: hybrid_seed_source
fields.title: Source of commercial hybrid seed
fields.description: Whether the commercial F1 seed of a hybrid is imported or produced in Bangladesh, where an NSB decision states it (an 'imported and trialled' hybrid, an F1 import permission, or parent-line imports for F1 production in Bangladesh). Never inferred from origin_country or the company. Values: imported; produced in Bangladesh; both; unknown (hybrid, not stated); blank for inbreds.

fields.name: hybrid_seed_source_evidence
fields.title: Evidence for hybrid_seed_source
fields.description: The NSB meeting and statement behind hybrid_seed_source. Values: Free text naming the meeting.

fields.name: depth_to_cgiar
fields.title: Generations to nearest CGIAR ancestor
fields.description: Number of generations between the variety and the nearest CGIAR line in its documented pedigree: 0 when the variety is a CGIAR line or a mutant, somaclone or selection of one, 1 when a parent is a CGIAR line, 2 for a grandparent, and so on. Blank means no CGIAR line was found within five generations of the documented pedigree, including the many varieties with no pedigree at all. Values: Integer 0-5; blank.

fields.name: nearest_cgiar_ancestor
fields.title: Nearest CGIAR ancestor
fields.description: Name or designation of the CGIAR line found at depth_to_cgiar (for example 'IR20', 'IR8', 'Oryza rufipogon (IRGC103404)'). For a mutant, somaclone or selection made directly from a CGIAR line (depth 0) it is the source line (NERICA-10 for Binadhan-19, IR8 for Iratom-24); a register variety (such as BR6) appears when it is itself a CGIAR line introduced and released. Values: Free text as printed in the pedigree.

fields.name: source_url_status
fields.title: Link status of source_url
fields.description: Result of the most recent automated check of the address in source_url. A status other than ok does not mean the archived copy is missing: the file itself is kept under 02_raw/. Values: ok; blocked_to_bots (HTTP 403: the page exists but refuses automated checks); dead (404, 410 or a soft error page); unreachable (DNS, TLS or timeout failure); unchecked. Blank when the link column is blank.

fields.name: archived_url_status
fields.title: Link status of archived_url
fields.description: Result of the most recent automated check of the address in archived_url. A status other than ok does not mean the archived copy is missing: the file itself is kept under 02_raw/. Values: ok; blocked_to_bots (HTTP 403: the page exists but refuses automated checks); dead (404, 410 or a soft error page); unreachable (DNS, TLS or timeout failure); unchecked. Blank when the link column is blank.

fields.name: cgiar_evidence_url_status
fields.title: Link status of cgiar_evidence_url
fields.description: Result of the most recent automated check of the address in cgiar_evidence_url. A status other than ok does not mean the archived copy is missing: the file itself is kept under 02_raw/. Values: ok; blocked_to_bots (HTTP 403: the page exists but refuses automated checks); dead (404, 410 or a soft error page); unreachable (DNS, TLS or timeout failure); unchecked. Blank when the link column is blank.

fields.name: doi_key_paper_status
fields.title: Link status of key-paper DOI
fields.description: Result of the automated check of https://doi.org/<DOI> for each DOI in doi_key_paper, in the same order. Values: ok; blocked_to_bots; dead; unreachable; unchecked; joined by '; '.

resources.name: bgd_sources
resources.title: One archived source file
resources.description: Every source file that supplied at least one eligible value: its identifier, title, authority rank, original and archived addresses, download date and SHA-256 checksum.

fields.name: source_id
fields.title: Source identifier
fields.description: Identifier of the source document or source group. A group identifier (such as one for all BRRI Rice Profile pages) can cover many files, so it is not unique; local_file is. Values: Short code.

fields.name: source_title
fields.title: Source title
fields.description: Title of the source. Values: Free text.

fields.name: authority_rank
fields.title: Authority rank
fields.description: Authority rank of the source, used to choose between disagreeing values. Lower numbers are more authoritative for legal facts such as approval dates; for descriptive fields (names, traits) assemble.py uses field-specific orders documented in the preface. Values: 1_primary_legal (NSB minutes, Bangladesh Gazette notifications, acts and rules); 2_official_list (SCA and MoA variety lists); 3_institute_page (BRRI, BINA, BFRI and university web pages, handbooks and fact sheets); 4_cgiar_record (CGIAR, IRRI, SPIA, HarvestPlus, WorldFish, ASTI/TRIVSA, GloMIP records); 5_peer_reviewed; 6_secondary (preprints, news, grey literature); 7_reviewer_synthesis (a value added by a reviewer with the file and page cited in the notes).

fields.name: local_file
fields.title: Archived file
fields.description: Path of the source file inside the archive, relative to the archive root. Every value in the archive can be traced to a page of a file under 02_raw/. Values: Relative path beginning '02_raw/'; the SHA-256 of each file is in bgd_sources.csv.

fields.name: source_url
fields.title: Original URL of main source
fields.description: Web address from which the main source file of the row was downloaded. For the rice register this is the file that supplied the approval record (approval_date); for other tables it is the file that supplied the row. Values: Absolute http(s) URL. Many Government of Bangladesh files are served from an Oracle object-storage address rather than a portal page; that is the address the portal links to.

fields.name: archived_url
fields.title: Wayback Machine copy
fields.description: Address of a copy of the same file in the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine, so that the source can be consulted if the original address changes. Blank means no archived copy was made or found; it does not mean the original is unavailable. Values: https://web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>/<original URL>.

fields.name: download_date
fields.title: Download date
fields.description: Date the file was downloaded. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: sha256
fields.title: SHA-256 checksum
fields.description: SHA-256 hash of the archived file, which lets a user verify that the copy in 02_raw/ is the file that was downloaded. Values: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

fields.name: source_url_status
fields.title: Link status of source_url
fields.description: Result of the most recent automated check of the address in source_url. A status other than ok does not mean the archived copy is missing: the file itself is kept under 02_raw/. Values: ok; blocked_to_bots (HTTP 403: the page exists but refuses automated checks); dead (404, 410 or a soft error page); unreachable (DNS, TLS or timeout failure); unchecked. Blank when the link column is blank.

fields.name: archived_url_status
fields.title: Link status of archived_url
fields.description: Result of the most recent automated check of the address in archived_url. A status other than ok does not mean the archived copy is missing: the file itself is kept under 02_raw/. Values: ok; blocked_to_bots (HTTP 403: the page exists but refuses automated checks); dead (404, 410 or a soft error page); unreachable (DNS, TLS or timeout failure); unchecked. Blank when the link column is blank.

resources.name: bgd_variety_crosswalk
resources.title: One variety code or label in one survey or library
resources.description: Rice variety codes in household surveys (BIHS 2011-12, 2015, 2018-19 and the SPIA 2024 round; the MIXTAPE 2026 questionnaire drafts of March and May, the questionnaire of 21 August 2026 and the SurveyCTO choice lists printed on 14 October 2026) and reference names in the SPIA DNA fingerprinting library, matched to register identifiers by their label text. Compact layout for reading: one row per source, code and label, with the variables that share them pooled in one cell. Merge on bgd_variety_crosswalk_long.csv instead. Codes are list positions that shift between rounds, so they must never be merged on the code number.

fields.name: source
fields.title: Survey or library
fields.description: Survey round or reference library that uses the code. Values: BIHS2011_12; BIHS2015; BIHS2018_19; BIHS2024_SPIA; MIXTAPE2026_draft (March and May 2026 drafts); MIXTAPE2026_0821 (21 August 2026 questionnaire); MIXTAPE2026_CAPI (SurveyCTO choice lists as printed on 14 October 2026); SPIA_DNA_reference.

fields.name: source_file
fields.title: Source file
fields.description: File from which the value labels or code list were read (labels and code lists only, never household records): .dta value labels, questionnaire exports, or the SurveyCTO printables. Values: Path relative to the BGD_MIX project folder.

fields.name: variable
fields.title: Variables
fields.description: Variables (or questionnaire code lists) that carry this code and label, pooled across files and drafts of the source. Use bgd_variety_crosswalk_long.csv, which has one variable per row, for merging. Values: Names joined by '; '.

fields.name: code
fields.title: Code
fields.description: Numeric code of the variety in the survey, or the reference name in the DNA library. Codes are list positions that differ between rounds; never merge on the code alone. Values: Integer, or text for the DNA library.

fields.name: label_as_printed
fields.title: Label as printed
fields.description: Value label of the code as printed in the survey file. Values: Free text.

fields.name: variety_id
fields.title: Variety identifier
fields.description: Register variety matched to the label. Blank for brand families, non-approved names, residual categories and unmatched labels. Values: 'RICE-' followed by a key built from the official name by lib_keys.make_key: BR<n> (BR series, 1970-1993), BRRI_DHAN<n>, BRRI_HYBRID<n>, BINADHAN<n>, IRATOM<n>, BINASHAIL, BU_, BAU_ and GAU_ (universities), BRAC_DHAN<n>, PVT_ (other private inbreds), HYB_<trade name> (private and BADC hybrids), IR<n> and OLD_ (pre-BRRI introductions and old names).

fields.name: variety_name
fields.title: Display name
fields.description: Display name of the matched variety. Values: Free text.

fields.name: match_type
fields.title: Match type
fields.description: How the label was matched; matching uses the label text only, never the code number. Values: exact_code_name (official series designation read from the label); normalised_name; alias; brand_family (trade name covering several registered products; members in candidate_ids); not_approved_variety (widely grown name without approval; see non_register_id); generic_label (residual categories such as 'Others'); unmatched.

fields.name: n_candidates
fields.title: Number of candidates
fields.description: Number of register varieties the label could refer to. Values: Count.

fields.name: candidate_ids
fields.title: Candidate varieties
fields.description: Register varieties the label could refer to, for brand families and unmatched brand members; listed for reference, not as a match. Values: variety_id values joined by ' | '.

fields.name: confidence
fields.title: Confidence
fields.description: The extracting agent's judgement of how secure the reading or the match is. Values: high; medium; low.

fields.name: note
fields.title: Note
fields.description: Reason for the match, or why there is none. Values: Free text.

fields.name: non_register_id
fields.title: Non-register identifier
fields.description: Stable identifier for widely grown names that have no Bangladesh approval. Values: 'NA_<NAME>' (e.g. NA_MINIKET, NA_HARIDHAN).

resources.name: bgd_variety_crosswalk_long
resources.title: One code of one survey variable in one instrument version
resources.description: The crosswalk in long format, the file to merge survey data on: one row per source, instrument version, variable and code, unique on that key (asserted by the build), with the same match columns as bgd_variety_crosswalk.csv. The March and May 2026 MIXTAPE drafts, the 21 August 2026 questionnaire and the SurveyCTO printables are separate instrument versions because they number the same codes differently. Brand-family rows add the rice types and CGIAR codes of the family's registered members. Plot-weighted match rates by round are in 06_validation/crosswalk_plot_coverage.csv.

fields.name: source
fields.title: Survey or library
fields.description: Survey round, questionnaire or reference library that uses the code. Values: BIHS2011_12; BIHS2015; BIHS2018_19; BIHS2024_SPIA; MIXTAPE2026_draft (March and May 2026 drafts); MIXTAPE2026_0821 (21 August 2026 questionnaire); MIXTAPE2026_CAPI (SurveyCTO choice lists as printed on 14 October 2026); SPIA_DNA_reference.

fields.name: instrument_version
fields.title: Instrument version
fields.description: Version of the questionnaire or data release within the source. Together with source, variable and code it forms the key of the table, which is unique; drafts that number the same code differently are separate versions. Values: 2011-12; 2015; 2018-19; 2024; 2026-03-03 draft; 2026-05-15 draft; 2026-08-21; CAPI male_resp_V1 (printed 2026-10-14); CAPI hhq_training_v2_all (printed 2026-10-14).

fields.name: survey_file
fields.title: Source file
fields.description: File from which the value labels or the code list were read (labels and code lists only, never household records). Values: Path relative to the BGD_MIX project folder; several files joined by '; ' when the same list is read from each.

fields.name: variable
fields.title: Variable
fields.description: Single survey variable, or questionnaire code list, that carries the code. One variable per row, so the table can be merged directly on the survey variable. Values: Variable name as in the survey file, or the code-list heading of the questionnaire (e.g. 'G1 variety: Code 2 Paddy Rice Varieties (Updated)').

fields.name: code
fields.title: Code
fields.description: Code of the variety in the survey variable, or the reference name in the DNA library. Codes are list positions that differ between rounds and instrument versions; merge on the full key, never on the code alone. Values: Integer; alphanumeric for the 21 August 2026 I5 table (e.g. '25a'); text for the DNA library.

fields.name: label_as_printed
fields.title: Label as printed
fields.description: Value label of the code as printed in the survey file or questionnaire. Values: Free text.

fields.name: variety_id
fields.title: Variety identifier
fields.description: Register variety matched to the label. Blank for brand families, non-approved names, residual categories, ambiguous aliases and unmatched labels. Values: variety_id of bgd_rice_varieties.csv.

fields.name: variety_name
fields.title: Display name
fields.description: Display name of the matched variety. Values: Free text.

fields.name: match_type
fields.title: Match type
fields.description: How the label was matched; as in bgd_variety_crosswalk.csv. Values: exact_code_name; normalised_name; alias; brand_family; not_approved_variety; generic_label; unmatched.

fields.name: n_candidates
fields.title: Number of candidates
fields.description: Number of register varieties the label could refer to. Values: Count.

fields.name: candidate_ids
fields.title: Candidate varieties
fields.description: Register varieties the label could refer to, for brand families, ambiguous aliases and unmatched brand members; listed for reference, not as a match. Values: variety_id values joined by ' | '.

fields.name: confidence
fields.title: Confidence
fields.description: The extracting agent's judgement of how secure the reading or the match is. Values: high; medium; low.

fields.name: note
fields.title: Note
fields.description: Reason for the match, or why there is none; also rules that depend on another survey variable (for example crop_a for BIHS 2011-12 codes 54 and 74). Values: Free text.

fields.name: non_register_id
fields.title: Non-register identifier
fields.description: Stable identifier for widely grown names that have no Bangladesh approval; attributes in bgd_non_register_names.csv. Values: 'NA_<NAME>' (e.g. NA_MINIKET, NA_GUTI_SWARNA).

fields.name: family_rice_type
fields.title: Brand family rice type
fields.description: For brand_family rows: whether the registered members of the family are all hybrids, all inbreds or a mix, so that a brand report can or cannot set a hybrid indicator. Blank for other rows. Values: all_hybrid; all_inbred; mixed.

fields.name: family_cgiar_roles
fields.title: Brand family CGIAR codes
fields.description: For brand_family rows: the distinct cgiar_role codes of the registered members, which bound the CGIAR content of a brand report. Blank for other rows. Values: Codes 1-5 joined by ' | '.

resources.name: bgd_variety_events
resources.title: One NSB decision event for one variety
resources.description: Every NSB decision linked to a variety, coded as an event (release, registration, extension, renaming, suspension, deferred denotification and others), with an English summary and a Bangla excerpt of the decision.

fields.name: variety_id
fields.title: Variety identifier
fields.description: Stable identifier of a rice variety in the register and the key for joining every table in the archive. The number inside the identifier is the official series number of the variety, not a running count. Values: 'RICE-' followed by a key built from the official name by lib_keys.make_key: BR<n> (BR series, 1970-1993), BRRI_DHAN<n>, BRRI_HYBRID<n>, BINADHAN<n>, IRATOM<n>, BINASHAIL, BU_, BAU_ and GAU_ (universities), BRAC_DHAN<n>, PVT_ (other private inbreds), HYB_<trade name> (private and BADC hybrids), IR<n> and OLD_ (pre-BRRI introductions and old names).

fields.name: variety_name
fields.title: Display name
fields.description: Display name of the variety. Values: Free text.

fields.name: event_date
fields.title: Event date
fields.description: Date of the NSB meeting at which the decision was taken. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: meeting_no
fields.title: NSB meeting
fields.description: NSB meeting number. Values: Integer.

fields.name: event_type
fields.title: Event type
fields.description: Kind of decision on the variety, refined from decision_type by keyword rules on the variety's own text. Values: release; provisional_release; full_release_after_provisional; registration; extension_season_or_region; registration_renewal_or_extension; rename; suspension; import_permission; rejection; recommendation_pending/deferred; denotification_proposed_deferred; condition_change; status_change_other; gazette_notification (defined); cancellation/denotification and transfer_of_registration are defined but do not occur.

fields.name: detail
fields.title: Detail
fields.description: English summary of the event, the meeting, and the season or region where given. Values: Free text.

fields.name: decision_text_excerpt
fields.title: Decision text (excerpt)
fields.description: Bangla source text of the decision, verbatim, cut to 400 characters. Values: Bangla text.

fields.name: source_file
fields.title: Archived file
fields.description: Path of the source file inside the archive, relative to the archive root. Every value in the archive can be traced to a page of a file under 02_raw/. Values: Relative path beginning '02_raw/'; the SHA-256 of each file is in bgd_sources.csv.

fields.name: page
fields.title: Page
fields.description: Page of the source file on which the value is printed, counted as the PDF page (1 = first page of the file), not the number printed on the page. Values: Integer page number, or a range 'a-b' when the item spans pages. Blank for web pages, spreadsheets and API records.

resources.name: bgd_variety_people
resources.title: One person named for one variety
resources.description: Authors of the key papers and breeders named in official or publication sources, with role, affiliation and ORCID as stated, and professional contact details only where the institution's official directory or the paper itself publishes them.

fields.name: variety_id
fields.title: Variety identifier
fields.description: Stable identifier of a rice variety in the register and the key for joining every table in the archive. The number inside the identifier is the official series number of the variety, not a running count. Values: 'RICE-' followed by a key built from the official name by lib_keys.make_key: BR<n> (BR series, 1970-1993), BRRI_DHAN<n>, BRRI_HYBRID<n>, BINADHAN<n>, IRATOM<n>, BINASHAIL, BU_, BAU_ and GAU_ (universities), BRAC_DHAN<n>, PVT_ (other private inbreds), HYB_<trade name> (private and BADC hybrids), IR<n> and OLD_ (pre-BRRI introductions and old names).

fields.name: person_name
fields.title: Person
fields.description: Name of the author or breeder as printed in the source. Values: Free text.

fields.name: author_position
fields.title: Author position
fields.description: Position of the person in the author list of the key paper. Values: 1 = first author.

fields.name: role_as_stated
fields.title: Role
fields.description: Role of the person with respect to the variety. Values: 'author of key paper (<publication type>)', with ' - corresponding author' where applicable; breeder roles from official sources.

fields.name: affiliation_as_stated
fields.title: Affiliation
fields.description: Affiliation printed for the person in the key paper. Values: Free text.

fields.name: orcid
fields.title: ORCID iD
fields.description: ORCID iD of the person, where registered. Values: 0000-0000-0000-0000 form.

fields.name: source
fields.title: Source
fields.description: Publication or document that names the person. Values: 'doi:<DOI>' or a URL.

fields.name: current_position_as_stated
fields.title: Current position
fields.description: Current post of the person according to the institution's official staff directory, as printed (often Bangla). Values: Free text.

fields.name: contact_source_url
fields.title: Contact source
fields.description: Page from which the contact details were taken. Values: Absolute URL(s) joined by ' | '.

fields.name: contact_source_type
fields.title: Contact source type
fields.description: Kind of page that supplied the contact. Values: 'official institutional directory (brri.gov.bd)', optionally with '; corresponding author ...'.

fields.name: notes
fields.title: Notes
fields.description: How the person was matched to the directory and how the author list was obtained. Values: Free text.

resources.name: bgd_variety_status
resources.title: One variety
resources.description: Legal status of each variety at February 2026 (after NSB meeting 115), with a plain-English basis and the date of the last event. It covers the register and the non-register names that have NSB decisions.

fields.name: variety_id
fields.title: Variety identifier
fields.description: Identifier of the variety: every register variety, plus names outside the register that have NSB decisions (for example Iratom-38, Jirashail and BRRI-shail); the basis column says 'not in the rice register' for these. Values: 'RICE-' followed by a key built from the official name by lib_keys.make_key: BR<n> (BR series, 1970-1993), BRRI_DHAN<n>, BRRI_HYBRID<n>, BINADHAN<n>, IRATOM<n>, BINASHAIL, BU_, BAU_ and GAU_ (universities), BRAC_DHAN<n>, PVT_ (other private inbreds), HYB_<trade name> (private and BADC hybrids), IR<n> and OLD_ (pre-BRRI introductions and old names).

fields.name: status_as_of_2026
fields.title: Legal status, February 2026
fields.description: Legal status of the variety after the last NSB meeting in the archive (meeting 115, 5 February 2026). 'Active' is a legal status under the Seeds Ordinance and says nothing about whether seed is produced or sold. Status is never inferred from elapsed time; no registration is coded as expired. Kept for compatibility; legal_status_2026 states the same finding in words. Values: active; suspended; unknown (no NSB approval on record, a time-limited approval with no recorded renewal, or an approval made conditional with no recorded outcome); cancelled (defined, but no case found).

fields.name: legal_status_2026
fields.title: Legal status in words, February 2026
fields.description: Legal status after the last NSB meeting in the archive (meeting 115, 5 February 2026), in words. 'Active' means approved with no adverse decision on record; the 20 varieties the SCA proposed for denotification in 2021 are flagged. Legal status says nothing about whether seed is produced or the variety is grown. Values: active; active, withdrawal proposed 2021 and deferred; time-limited registration, renewal not recorded; provisional, re-evaluation outcome not recorded; seed multiplication suspended; suspended; recommended before the Board, no later decision; not approved (names outside the register, status file only).

fields.name: basis
fields.title: Basis of legal status
fields.description: Plain-English statement of the decision or absence of decisions behind status_as_of_2026, naming the meeting and date. Values: Free text.

fields.name: last_event_date
fields.title: Date of last event
fields.description: Date of the last NSB decision on the variety, or its register approval date when no decision is linked. Values: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or year only.

fields.name: hybrid_seed_source
fields.title: Source of commercial hybrid seed
fields.description: Whether the commercial F1 seed of a hybrid is imported or produced in Bangladesh, where an NSB decision states it (an 'imported and trialled' hybrid, an F1 import permission, or parent-line imports for F1 production in Bangladesh). Never inferred from origin_country or the company. Values: imported; produced in Bangladesh; both; unknown (hybrid, not stated); blank for inbreds.

fields.name: hybrid_seed_source_evidence
fields.title: Evidence for hybrid_seed_source
fields.description: The NSB meeting and statement behind hybrid_seed_source. Values: Free text naming the meeting.
